Peter,

**Can I count on you?**

Thank you,

| | |
Peter,

I don't have good news today...

**Recent polling shows my Democrat opponent, Raphael Warnock, leading by 3 points.** For months we've been in a dead heat, but now I'm slightly behind in Georgia's crucial Senate showdown.

This is a significant setback for Republicans everywhere.

I wish that was the only piece of bad news I had for you today, but it's not...

My Democrat opponent is the _leading _fundraiser in the entire country. He's raising record amounts of money in record time. The latest report shows he raised $17 MILLION in the last 3 MONTHS. If I'm going to catch up, I need MAJOR reinforcements, which is why I'm reaching out to you today, Peter. _**[I need you to rush an emergency contribution of ANY AMOUNT to help us close the fundraising gap.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61255479:6WHKEKVkN:m:1:3334294963:380C3532FAF2C550CC02C0A1CF34E754:r "It’s important that we band
together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

There's too much at stake to sit on the sidelines. _Georgia is in danger. Our Senate majority is in danger. The future of our country is in danger._

Democrat Super PACs and my opponent have already spent $25 million in false attack ads against me, which is why we've lost ground in the polls. _Unfortunately, we haven't had the money to respond or set the record straight._

This is just the beginning... Democrats are already scheming on how to spend another $25 MILLION. _**[They MUST be STOPPED.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61255479:6WHKEKVkN:m:1:3334294963:380C3532FAF2C550CC02C0A1CF34E754:r "It’s
important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

It's clear that they see me as a threat. The fate of the Senate majority will be determined by the outcome of our race in Georgia. That's why we must fully fund our ads and grassroots efforts to make sure Georgians learn the truth about Raphael Warnock's far-left record.

_**[Peter I need your help now more than ever. If you're able, would you please contribute $25 or more to help us close the fundraising gap? Every penny counts, and your help is CRITICAL.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61255479:6WHKEKVkN:m:1:3334294963:380C3532FAF2C550CC02C0A1CF34E754:r "It’s important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it
takes to pull off a win.")**_

Thank you for your support.

Onward to victory,

Herschel Walker
Republican for U.S. Senate

| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zm2akmnnl99g389pipvp228iib0fusi6ichsma38_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjjm6o76c1h2bs)**

---
| | And today, we want to send a copy to your inbox for FREE.

Inside this important eBook, you'll get a clear analysis of some of the biggest political and economic myths infecting our world today like:
* Overpopulation is destroying the world
* Global climate change can be reversed by law
* Capitalism creates winners and losers
* Socialism helps the poor

You can get your free copy using this secure link:

**[https://act.libertasutah.org/tt-the-tuttle-rebuttals](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zcvbcbs6ovp97q1ivk1e2hp6h2h1lk567kba1088_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjjm6o76c1h2bs)**

I'd also love for you to share this book with at least 5 people you know--especially any children in your family. My hope is that they will enjoy the same benefits you do when you read this book. And then, we can crush these myths once and for all.

**The Rhode Island primary is here and this Tuesday, September 13th, we are leaving nothing to chance!** David Segal understands that we must go all in, in the fight for future generations to inherit a livable and more equitable planet! David has been a dedicated, 20-year long civil servant of his community. He is a former Providence city councilor and former state representative who has prioritized progressive policy and coalition building. As a city councilor, David co-led efforts to make Providence one of the first capital cities in the U.S. to adopt a renewable energy mandate and established a renewable energy commission. body:
You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox:
[View this message in your browser](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z0la8s2jeq7rap74i6325p6n6th55g7sr9jn91jg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkeq32t5nmeq33cjl61qn4cdkmoq37c3nm6or9ctn6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf1o3gmkqeecpheeor8t326krb6stkeloj8c9l6ion4o5lm5rb2s3nmoqj0t37c3jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m9p6ccln6ko6fchicooj1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn48d245p25oh4cdhm4p70s1gm4or24no)
[](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z8hg838h90cjulmuihdqfjthrfh4iu7eman4mo30_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjge0ob2cdh2bs)

Friend,

You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox:
* Big tech is silencing pro-liberty voices
* Universities are running amok with radical socialists
* The mainstream media openly lies to the public
* Corporate America has embraced Woke propaganda
* Pelosi and her cronies are passing a radical agenda in Congress

Despite all this: _**Yes, there is hope for the future**_.

_What if I told you the thing that gives me the MOST hope are our college students?_ You'd think I was crazy. Aren't they all radicals too?

**Wrong. **

A group of college students is fighting for liberty and may be one of our greatest chances of saving our Republic. Here are a few of their recent victories...
* Helped pass Constitutional Carry in Texas, Indiana, and Alabama!
* Helped expand School Choice in Kentucky, Arizona, and Missouri!
* Adding over 250 hardcore pro-liberty legislators to a national coalition across the country!
* SUED dozens of college campuses and restored free speech rights to over 1.5 million college students!

College students are lining up to defend Constitutional principles and grow a coalition of liberty legislators across the country. Here's how they are doing it.

Allow me to personally introduce Lauren Daugherty. She is the CEO of Young Americans for Liberty (YAL). YAL is the most active and effective pro-liberty youth organization advancing liberty on campus and in American electoral politics.

**Friend, I told Lauren I would help YAL raise $23,000 online. It will go directly towards YAL 's work to fight for laws that advance liberty, train students to become door knockers before the 2022 elections, and so much more. I am asking for your immediate support now to get 1,000 students mobilized for freedom. **

[_**Donate $10 >>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zb4b2ks30psfp17bm0fn49hvbin7s61n1tvdvaf0_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjge0ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $20.22 >>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z6tfnn87007sj23obtp8g2fj422a34f7mfnkkhlo_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjge0ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zet2vk5n8lbie17l5486irk32sok68fce29fqio8_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjge0ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zitttg3q75jp89nd127ekko1287ud7klp3r1ns08_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjge0ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $210 to sponsor a student >>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zoksekh20q9rqhrv3va1uvgc10seecq7ar040smg_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjge0ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $420 to sponsor two students >>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zu2vte52tkq8vgg9j8ak9g6db91te60iua54td30_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjge0ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zitgm0gc486ran9q99g97vt14nvlud3ij7m9qg90_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjge0ob2cdh2bs)

Here's how it works.

> **First:** YAL recruits tens of thousands of students across college campuses. These students start and join an active YAL chapter where they fight back against leftist bias on campus.
>
> **Next:** YAL takes the top student leaders and brings them to top notch trainings. There, students are taught how to transform their campus and fight for liberty candidates and causes in the legislature.
>
> **Then:** Thousands of student activists recruited and trained by YAL knock on doors to push liberty legislation, and turn out the vote for liberty-minded candidates running for office.
>
> **Finally:** These liberty legislators pass bills to defend freedom of speech, protect the 2nd Amendment, and expand free markets.

The results speak volumes of this successful formula to make liberty WIN:

YAL's student activists have helped elect over 250 pro-liberty legislators, repealed 99 unconstitutional free speech codes and regulations, and have started chapters on over 500 college campuses across the country.

All of this hinges on training the next generation of liberty patriots.

Can you join me today to help YAL defend our liberty and train the next generation of liberty activists? Click below to send your urgent support.

[_**Donate $20.22 >>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z9qugktm7cke8n0hokoeh5fgsl2vg7g6epeoo8d0_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjge0ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zd51l3c6ml870ancmahcahsgfbpmddcoju3gl2h8_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjge0ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zknfefv815os2jrgrai4ot7t0397mjegptv0eivg_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjge0ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $210 to sponsor a student >>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z2ajoovar0jp7tvlhv48es93op3tbu5926instio_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjge0ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $420 to sponsor two students >>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z1q06obidaasipvt98s73sjnuran44c7cjguigug_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjge0ob2cdh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>**_](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zjvc1aqi9t0ahrk3lto5l5fd4d201ctecvglmc70_rp22sh2s8i66or2cjge0ob2cdh2bs)

Senator Rand Paul

A seismic shift in our culture is required to make a change and restore liberty in the United States.

name: Delegate John McGuire III
subject: Huge News for Virginia Veterans!
disclaimer_text: Paid for and Authorized by Friends of John McGuire
body:
Reduce Taxes on Veteran Retirement Pay
---
| | | | | |
VA Delegate John McGuire
I'm running for State Senate in 2023 so we can "Un-California" Virginia.
Christian Conservative (Father - Navy SEAL - Business Owner)

---
| [ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001KmCjioJ0thy3qV1dX0-iu4G9nP0B0q3OMJVmM7Ag_L2pSzrU0-XDAVj4EYZfRYB4p584oI_tRMgY0P5heGSrTkWhat27MHU7MqiYpqpwRN851EvkHK5ZVxog5MDVtdR89qapoTeK-7l037Kb2wAIziFMiUSMqNFGgQrP5utpjuSBeMTgAxn6rA==&c=UXhUI3dMHuG2RWTzBJHnnEk11xyPEQxKjQCDzn8wioeMGGbY7SFSnQ==&ch=isnnytOVwOXLg5RRMx1EVbrh8ZVFfSDDbtS-bLs_J0hO_SB3MtNbug==)
---
| Fellow Virginians,
For 30 years, Virginia legislators worked hard to reduce taxes on veteran retirement pay with no result. With a lot of teamwork, Governor Youngkin just signed my bill HB1128 ([click here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001KmCjioJ0thy3qV1dX0-iu4G9nP0B0q3OMJVmM7Ag_L2pSzrU0-XDAVj4EYZfRYB4p584oI_tRMgY0P5heGSrTkWhat27MHU7MqiYpqpwRN851EvkHK5ZVxog5MDVtdR89qapoTeK-7l037Kb2wAIziFMiUSMqNFGgQrP5utpjuSBeMTgAxn6rA==&c=UXhUI3dMHuG2RWTzBJHnnEk11xyPEQxKjQCDzn8wioeMGGbY7SFSnQ==&ch=isnnytOVwOXLg5RRMx1EVbrh8ZVFfSDDbtS-bLs_J0hO_SB3MtNbug==)) the largest veteran tax decrease in Virginia history and the Senate version SB 528 into law. Thank you Governor Youngkin for trusting me to fight hard to get HB 1128 to reduce taxes on veteran retirement pay up to $40k. California is now one of only 2 states that fully tax veteran retirement pay. As we strive to un-California Virginia, I am glad Virginia no longer has that in common with California. It really is amazing what we can achieve when we put our differences aside and work as a team. We have much more work to do.
For veterans age 55 and up, retired Virginia veterans now have an income tax subtraction for up to $10,000 of military benefits in the taxable year 2022, $20,000 in 2023, $30,000 in 2024, and $40,000 in 2025. Especially now during these times with high inflation and the price on everything continuing to go up, we all know veterans who could use this benefit. Please help us share this information far and wide with veterans all across Virginia!
Back in January, the Senate version submitted by Senator Reeves SB 528 [click here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001KmCjioJ0thy3qV1dX0-iu4G9nP0B0q3OMJVmM7Ag_L2pSzrU0-XDAVj4EYZfRYB4c0nqX7jz7cTc9C8wy46gGHijyofy-knXSRUkh6FjjdRsfunj2Fxi_6CRh0NSuxTFra_RB8NgoCA_HOAgtQ9AsZJjbSfJW9SET-M7X4aAB2CcO2MsSY-T7Bjwvvvg3IBEeGtlJAzECUE=&c=UXhUI3dMHuG2RWTzBJHnnEk11xyPEQxKjQCDzn8wioeMGGbY7SFSnQ==&ch=isnnytOVwOXLg5RRMx1EVbrh8ZVFfSDDbtS-bLs_J0hO_SB3MtNbug==) would only reduce the tax deduction for our veterans by $15k and it had an age requirement of 65. I knew that was not enough to make a difference for our E5 & E6 military folks and I knew we could do better.
My House version HB 1128 [click here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001KmCjioJ0thy3qV1dX0-iu4G9nP0B0q3OMJVmM7Ag_L2pSzrU0-XDAVdbuFDeMS78VxpbsFEjQwU7aN4EfooWi8nJyk3VW5ZzEG42m8bOLd-0oxvNG1RRDrEqMmQCB18ZO4nxa8EYyydUeBVvoHHYZz_-RaEHuXGDGATrSh7gElkFo6_uQMSL6NFEwHYOwIhaURG_jQDON9s=&c=UXhUI3dMHuG2RWTzBJHnnEk11xyPEQxKjQCDzn8wioeMGGbY7SFSnQ==&ch=isnnytOVwOXLg5RRMx1EVbrh8ZVFfSDDbtS-bLs_J0hO_SB3MtNbug==) would reduce taxes for our veterans by $40k and had no age requirement. Even though I was asked to lower my number, I held my ground on the $40k. With the help of many, especially Delegate Barry Knight Chairman of the House Appropriations Committee, we negotiated back and forth and prevailed with the $40k but we had to compromise with the Senate by adding an age 55 requirement. Thank you Senator Reeves for everything you did including helping us get the age requirement compromise. In the 12th hour, I actually walked into the Democrat state Senate caucus to ensure we received the final signatures. This huge bipartisan effort will help us keep military talent in Virginias workforce and will help improve Virginias economy.
Governor Youngkin's message to Virginia veterans is clear, we appreciate your service and we want you to stay. Christian Conservative (Father - Navy SEAL - Business Owner) | == | Fellow Virginians, For 30 years, Virginia legislators worked hard to reduce taxes on veteran retirement pay with no result. Thank you Governor Youngkin for trusting me to fight hard to get HB 1128 to reduce taxes on veteran retirement pay up to $40k. California is now one of only 2 states that fully tax veteran retirement pay. As we strive to un-California Virginia, I am glad Virginia no longer has that in common with California. It really is amazing what we can achieve when we put our differences aside and work as a team. We have much more work to do. For veterans age 55 and up, retired Virginia veterans now have an income tax subtraction for up to $10,000 of military benefits in the taxable year 2022, $20,000 in 2023, $30,000 in 2024, and $40,000 in 2025. Especially now during these times with high inflation and the price on everything continuing to go up, we all know veterans who could use this benefit. Please help us share this information far and wide with veterans all across Virginia! Back in January, the Senate version submitted by Senator Reeves SB 528 == would only reduce the tax deduction for our veterans by $15k and it had an age requirement of 65. I knew that was not enough to make a difference for our E5 & E6 military folks and I knew we could do better. My House version HB 1128 == would reduce taxes for our veterans by $40k and had no age requirement. Even though I was asked to lower my number, I held my ground on the $40k. Thank you Senator Reeves for everything you did including helping us get the age requirement compromise. name: Christine Drazan
subject: May we never forget them.
body:
This morning I had the honor of speaking at the 9/11 Remembrance Ceremony in Canby and to meet some of those front line heroes.
For those on the front lines-for those who lost their lives on September 11th, 2001, we honor them today.For those who served and witnessed unimaginable suffering-for those who have since left public service-_we honor them, we thank them for their service, we thank them for their sacrifice and we thank them for their courage._ This morning I had the honor of speaking at the 9/11 Remembrance Ceremony in Canby _and to meet some of those front line heroes._ Thank you for keeping us safer. Thank you for choosing to act. Thank you for choosing public service, knowing the toll it may take, knowing the risks you may face and knowing the price others have paid. _Thank you._ It's hard to believe, but it has been twenty-one years since that day.Today we fulfill our promise as a nation, _to honor and never forget._ But let's do more than honor great sacrifice, with ceremony alone. _Let 's do our part._ In ways big and small, let us serve. Each day. This is our time, our responsibility, to rise up, to defend, unify and heal our community through the challenges and setbacks, fires and ice storms, broken institutions and forgotten civility. The future does not belong to hate, to evil, lawlessness, or division._It belongs to us_ , to the ones who believe in our national values of freedom, equality and liberty for all, who are willing to stumble, but press on, to tread a rocky, imperfect path, to a more perfect union.May God bless the families and loved ones of the victims and survivors, of our first responders and our fallen heroes-and may God bless Oregon and the United States of America.Christine Drazan | [Unsubscribe](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-u-nydira-iukrjimdh-r/)

name: Matt Whitaker
subject: 50 FOIAs for the FBI
body:
We’re getting to the bottom of the Mar-a-Lago raid, and we need your help [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0774%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=lwW0TxC6rYPMz0nbRO3Aqg&sysid=1)
| | | Fellow patriot, Former President Trump is going on the offensive and appears to be launching a full-scale fight against the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). We here at the America First Policy Institute are joining the fight. I’m sure you already know the backstory: The FBI recently raided former President Trump’s home in what could be politically-motivated. This ordeal should paint a clear picture for us: The deep state is real, and we can’t afford to sit around playing defense while the FBI raids a former President’s home. **_We MUST go on the offensive._** [**And that’s exactly what I plan to do. Will you help me?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33817%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=yHpvWjFYs%2fZA%2f%2b%2boaq8sgg&sysid=1) _Our country is at risk of crumbling into a banana republic run by the most radical leftists in America and an invulnerable deep state. WE HAVE NO CHOICE BUT TO FIGHT BACK!_ When the news broke, our entire team sprung into action to respond. Within 48 hours, we filed more than 50 Freedom of Information Act requests to expose the Biden Administration and find out who knew what and when. But I assure you, the Department of Justice (DOJ) is not going to hand over information easily, and we may have to battle with the DOJ for months or even YEARS to uncover the truth fully. **We CANNOT sustain our efforts without you ... ** **[Will you chip in before it’s to help ensure our efforts can continue?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33818%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NiZlfG8QXYsONOIX%2b%2b9yUA&sysid=1)**[ ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33819%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ndlnim9YV2F%2bSEXN5rlbaQ&sysid=1) Let me back up. My name is Matt Whitaker... I was appointed acting United States Attorney General under former President Trump. In that role, I protected Law and Order both at home and abroad. Today I am Co-Chair of the Center for Law & Justice at the America First Policy Institute, where we strive to protect and preserve the rule of law in this great Nation. Together, we will fight back against the radical Left and end its unjust weaponization of the FBI. The team at America First Policy Institute is the best in the Nation, and we’re ready to make a HUGE difference for our country--ESPECIALLY when it comes to uncovering the truth regarding the FBI raid. [**I hope you’ll consider sending in a donation of $15, $25, or $50 today. ** ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33810%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=MSG5QNhbaBPcWima6E%2fNaA&sysid=1) Sincerely, Matt Whitaker Co-Chair, Center for Law & Justice America First Policy Institute P.S. We’ve seen it time and time again. Castro’s Cuba. Stalin's Russia. Nazi Germany. Mao’s China. Great nations fall to tyranny when governments weaponize law enforcement against patriots and political opponents. [**I’ll fight with every breath to make sure that America doesn’t have the same fate. Will you? ** ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33811%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2MsculeswLOOugAuX5f9mw&sysid=1)

**I am an Evangelical Christian** that came to know Jesus Christ 40 years ago through bible study led by fellow cadets at the United States Military Academy.

**_I keep an open Bible on my desk and read from it every day._**

From its incomparable wisdom, I sought and attained the tools of leadership I needed to succeed and acquired the belief in a better world to come.

I learned that Christ gives each of us important work to do and that wisdom comes from humility and is enshrined by forgiveness.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61259050:JBDEvKVXN:m:1:3253819041:318629D34D65C84B178C2F732E1526B3:r)
---

Unfortunately, humility and forgiveness are virtues that our leaders in Washington disregard. Instead, they exude unfounded arrogance and display hatefulness to their fellow Americans.
**Our nation CAN NOT continue to be dominated by petty, amoral, and transactional politics!**
---
| | [ELECT FAITH-DRIVEN LEADERS](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61259050:JBDEvKVXN:m:1:3253819041:318629D34D65C84B178C2F732E1526B3:r)
---

If we are to restore morality and integrity to our nation's capital, _**[we MUST elect faith-driven leaders](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61259050:JBDEvKVXN:m:1:3253819041:318629D34D65C84B178C2F732E1526B3:r "we MUST elect faith-driven leaders")**_ who will let God - _**not self-interest**_ \- be their guide.

If you agree, _**[please spare whatever you can](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61259050:JBDEvKVXN:m:1:3253819041:318629D34D65C84B178C2F732E1526B3:r "please spare whatever you can")**_ to support Christian conservatives who will lead with humility and show forgiveness to their fellow man.

God Bless,

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 12
CITIZENS FOR A GREATER GEORGIA LAUNCHES STATEWIDE WOMEN'S OUTREACH EFFORT (ATLANTA) -Today, Citizens for a Greater Georgia launched its outreach campaign to mobilize women across the state on behalf of Georgia's Republican State Senators, and conservative candidates up and down the ballot. Chaired by former State Representative Meagan Hanson, Women for a Greater Georgia is coordinating with state and local campaigns to host a series of events in key [target districts](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LMfzJt9NE_CLgdoY-4KDvtq2a9wV339J8n5gtj_TMygo49HdNzi9Tp19HuyEzRR3T1ppCWf2au2_f9FsOlZeMYAMarX0LhHLAC6uvKUbQXRt-JYe_IYHwr6gDxugGb1POfJbs8o7o_-pY0GaU5qe4sUA3EyYsHdT0a4M0ux_T9bLGHdEDMlOeJ2evcb6-gxEtkRjCbR3RQEE85aupeIbmGhnIR_0K0Tk7mGZ267iEECEbbFz5QJWS5K4xy49Lh9HFxsGekwIbSNxFBsJOr8BB10fpm0Ioma59k0Yx90T9JaT5afTCN0ErKxzHMeaPWvO&c=gzbsdYMa9C0TMBovXi1hnr_RZtb1-f6Gql8jU3UaYxjfZUVjZy98jw==&ch=uHqTLVdTeD7ckwGR993LAnHX5Cf0Y9q3EtB2y1eGYmMYWWtPTH6VtA==) and counties outside the metro area. The statewide campaign will conduct targeted outreach by phone, text, digital ads and mail, focusing on newly registered, disengaged and disenfranchised voters. "In contrast to the portrayal by the media and Washington politicians, not every strong American woman is a liberal. They are proud mothers, businesswomen and community leaders - who want to protect the American Dream, and to restore security and opportunity for their families," said former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler. "Women for a Greater Georgia is engaging with women across our state, welcoming their voices in the conservative movement, and mobilizing them ahead of November. With women representing over 52% of registered voters, we will determine Georgia's future - a future that is red, from the State Senate to the top of the ticket."

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWP_7_DhcN

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only
take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives-but
supported by many well-meaning Americans-to change the way we
elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the
Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWP_7_DhcN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent
matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but
the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by
progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to
change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do
away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our
Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a
National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to
me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more
clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning
this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and
opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on
Presidential Selection by using the link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60752531:WP_7_DhcN:m:3:2532013465:3D14B9AB0586CC007817856B6729208A:r

For most of our nation's history, the
Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution,
was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to
preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have
joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional
bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution
has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to
provide young people with a proper grounding in American
civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance
of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has
expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide,
directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the
Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide
through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The
Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over 5.6 million households and
businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of
liberty;

Promoting constitutional education
through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of
America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across
America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education
through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which
launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools
nationwide.

Your answers to the National Survey on
Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most
effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the
importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this
critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent
topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection
and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a
few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure
link I've provided below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60752531:WP_7_DhcN:m:3:2532013465:3D14B9AB0586CC007817856B6729208A:r

And after you take your survey, I hope you
will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing
truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its
extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is
essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the
National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for
your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of
liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

# Officer Dillon Vakoff
---
|
---
---
| | |
---|---
|
On Sunday, Arvada Officer Dillon Vakoff was tragically shot and killed in the line of duty while responding to a family disturbance.
Before becoming a police officer, Dillon served 6 years in the U.S. Air Force; he clearly had a heart for service. The Arvada police chief stated Officer Vakoff was an "example of everything that is good," in a police officer. As law enforcement is stretched thinner than ever before, and Colorado cities experience the highest crime rate in decades, this is a terrible loss we cannot afford.
As your Congressman, I swear to do all in my power to protect our law enforcement officers, counter the dangerous soft-on-crime measures being pushed by irresponsible politicians, and reverse the insidious de-fund the police movement that has undermined law enforcement's ability to do their job, making our streets more dangerous. This insanity must stop now.
Our prayers and sincerest condolences go out to Officer Vakoff's family, friends and fellow law enforcement as we join in mourning the loss of one of America's finest.
Erik Aadland
Congressional Candidate

|
---
| | | My name is Yesli Vega. I want to tell you about a moment that changed my life. I was leaving church with my family when I received the worst phone call of my life, that my brother had been gunned down by MS-13 gang members. That day I saw a friend lose his life and my brother severely wounded. From then on, my life would never be the same. I pledged to dedicate everything I had to protect my community and my family by becoming a cop - making sure no family would ever endure the terror and grief that we experienced. So when the Democrats called for defunding the police, I couldn't stand by and let these radicals destroy our communities. I knew I had to fight back. [**I 've taken on MS-13, and now I'm ready to fight the Radical Left in Washington. Nancy Pelosi is TERRIFIED of me because I'm everything she hates:**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61261944:JNiOiKVNa:m:1:3253819041:847CB1DDF357B1E606232F265E8391C2:r "I’ve taken
on MS-13, and now I’m ready to fight the Radical Left in Washington. Nancy Pelosi is TERRIFIED of me because I’m everything she
hates:")
* Conservative Latina
* Pro-law enforcement
* Military wife

Hello,
Well, it didn’t take long. **Less than an hour after I was declared the Democratic nominee for Senate in Iowa, the attacks from Chuck Grassley began.**
_“The most liberal nominee in Iowa Senate history”
“Radical”
“Socialist”_
Gotta love it!
Chuck Grassley doesn’t know what to say about me. He’s never faced an opponent like me before. I’m his political nightmare, so he’s just throwing cow pies at the wall and hoping something sticks.
Calling me “radical” is laughable when Chuck Grassley supports a complete ban on abortion and letting literally anyone buy an AR-15 without even a background check. **But there’s one attack that I absolutely won’t take lying down, and that’s Chuck Grassley’s attacking me for serving our country for 36 years in the U.S. Navy.**
Grassley is already trying to say that because I enlisted in the military at age 19, because my deployments meant that my family had to move from state-to-state and country-to-country... that I’m not an Iowan anymore.
Chuck Grassley wants to pretend that I wasn’t raised in rural, northwest Iowa. He ignores the enormous sacrifices that my family – my wife and my kids – made to allow me to serve in the Navy.
**Grassley’s attacks denigrate every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, spend holidays away from each other, and be absent from life’s big events like weddings and the birth of a child.**
**And if Chuck Grassley thinks that I will stand silent while he says that every Iowan who puts on our country’s uniform stops being an Iowan... he’s delusional.**
These are the kinds of attacks I’m up against. Nasty stuff from Chuck Grassley, Mitch McConnell, and the Fox ‘Entertainment’ News propaganda network.
There’s one reason why: The GOP is scared. They’ve seen the polls, and they know that if we defeat Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, Democrats are guaranteed to maintain our Senate majority.

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50587609/366446121/-707005773?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NmQxYWEyZS1iNTMyLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=d9LbLvS7bNGTYrL6CflHGPlw66GbZl_BZSuAF6ltRNU=)
Peter, it’s Senator Alex Padilla.

So much is at stake in the coming midterm election, and Californians have a unique opportunity to protect our democracy by unseating extremists like Republican Ken Calvert who tried to overturn the 2020 presidential election.

Dozens of grassroots leaders and climate organizations mobilized frontline communities and allies from across the country for a day of resistance and people power in Washington, DC. Over 600 people gathered for the “No Sacrifice Zones” Rally, which thrummed with solidarity, truth-telling, music and art. We were there to bear witness and amplify the voices of those living in environmental Sacrifice Zones, and to show massive public opposition to the Manchin-Schumer Dirty Side Deal, which threatens to fast-track the Mountain Valley Pipeline and curtail public input in the energy projects proposed for our own backyards.
During the first part of the day, the same voices that shared their stories on the rally stage courageously lobbied their Congressional Representatives to urge them to oppose the Dirty Side Deal. Over 50 meetings took place. One of our NC teams successfully moved Rep. Price’s office to pledge to oppose the deal, and at almost that exact moment, we got word that [Senator Bernie Sanders](https://url1005.email.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDMIPdX8Puw-31cfDAIdWQgFW7ZDnnU90iL3uvTZVeRjcMmC06cN6vygPwK_Lklpy5j-nOE2Bs7LNS56s7aJQ4f3gtOoWlzMyQmvkzJNhvPxMJAy3ycPIzjY9na0vbDxfRGvj-EsjBbp0d_kCVfAJm78QsKgD94YenO2vTVeoc9YgDEdmha3H0044WPnIjBViYo85EmEwqXbKdeoxHDcWh93xkSA-o8oT2TIZKprYfK6CS-LQtyVM0XJPP5MCCQwUckVo2GpqH2MWNk04FGfE0utQ6Z9os_XI6hZ75LWV4aMl2bMB7vLHmguDGtqUNhO6fZPrCZp8uWWKrAufvqjo6WSEVLFXh6BPIzyVgsRwnyUR9IlvO8mxkSCMzcc1XXY6Y3Zqux4WQHdSOozNhezxGB8/3pe/juHR5W_4RsK77qos1ppyAA/h2/wGO3Qnm06hFpZEruBZRY9MMf5QSkRrW3BUg87i8cePs) was addressing his colleagues on the Senate floor with the same demand. As of this morning, over [70 House Democrats](https://url1005.email.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/dSCQfi9FLISmU3ZE3bfPhs3UX1R5PjVx7g94_rPBVB-5UzKCShDa8i-6L4P_iGDY5pxA3vpzKjlAPniShRao6xDfM7BdjaCzuzAAQuhbteBjPw2fViIdioEh-FaNk9ToNXkzxklr4ucpyrb73xcOUU6h6QpY9PK5mcvMSxFkfQp94kGQF-aY4fNZ1HHRJ2MKU0pZX-_dgHZugznl_o9N8KcK-p4BBi8MBR07560Col_iLD0OrQ800Vuz_WFZKnlQYMMMPUz_WFxqDaJiq4fLkqsFSEoRjPpJP7jveGzStngKjyge_H2knkYsUENywQ5NK_GFZ-gw03g2Q_Myf9GYLbcxDNXTSB5kOQbnZxw0g1EBEITLwfOqJx4_scWuzSDl5H0DCQ7nGBvJy5PIBSsdaw2jhgvdJIav5b-g8ZFl1NTSxlLm-9PTiBFUK2V50sW7/3pe/juHR5W_4RsK77qos1ppyAA/h3/6xWH5bZQblI8mGCQFC94CYIaowL_cv2jghDUJ11erLE) have joined the push against the Dirty Deal. _The ripple effects of our collective efforts are real._

clean_body: | | | Dozens of grassroots leaders and climate organizations mobilized frontline communities and allies from across the country for a day of resistance and people power in Washington, DC. Over 600 people gathered for the “No Sacrifice Zones” Rally, which thrummed with solidarity, truth-telling, music and art. We were there to bear witness and amplify the voices of those living in environmental Sacrifice Zones, and to show massive public opposition to the Manchin-Schumer Dirty Side Deal, which threatens to fast-track the Mountain Valley Pipeline and curtail public input in the energy projects proposed for our own backyards. During the first part of the day, the same voices that shared their stories on the rally stage courageously lobbied their Congressional Representatives to urge them to oppose the Dirty Side Deal. Over 50 meetings took place. One of our NC teams successfully moved Rep. Price’s office to pledge to oppose the deal, and at almost that exact moment, we got word that was addressing his colleagues on the Senate floor with the same demand. As of this morning, over have joined the push against the Dirty Deal. The ripple effects of our collective efforts are real. | A vote is expected by September 30, 2022. We must continue to make our voices heard. Our elected officials need to hear directly from us -- their constituents. The fossil fuel industry is working hard to pass this deal and we need to work harder to stop them. There are 2 key ways to do this: 1\. Call Members of Congress → 2\. I’m Karoline Leavitt, the 25-year-old conservative firebrand from New Hampshire who doesn’t cower in the face of dirty politics.
Despite McCarthy and the Establishment’s best efforts, **I’m tied in the polls with the Establishment’s hand-picked puppet** ahead of my primary on Tuesday.

| | These are trying times. Our democracy is threatened from many directions, and it can feel overwhelming. As Election Day gets closer, we're seeing more and bolder attacks on voting rights. But we're also seeing unprecedented efforts to protect our democratic institutions and safeguard the will of the people. **Here are five threats to our democracy and one thing we can do about it:**
1. **The Big Lie.** Donald Trump's rhetoric leading up to the January 6 insurrection resulted in the deadliest attack on the Capitol since 1814. And while the events of that day could have brought our nation together, dozens of Republican candidates have doubled down on the lies; **this year, more than half of all Americans will have a ballot with an election denier on it**. [**This article provides an eye-opening look at the election deniers around the country running for Governor, Secretary of State, Attorney General, as well as the US House and Senate.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50591987/366460109/-19484742?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NGYxMGM3MS1iZDMyLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=suuamc0ngr-isadSJCymZZsCQKkBbWzquGI9RLeH588=&emci=400d0acf-3631-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=74f10c71-bd32-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=26261389)

2. **Attacks on voting rights.** Over the last decade, anti-democratic radicals have systematically dismantled the Voting Rights Act of 1965. As of today,**19 states have passed laws that make it more difficult, particularly for people of color and economically disadvantaged communities, to vote.**[**Read about how voting rights are already affecting the 2022 election here.** ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50591993/366460110/-1197727865?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NGYxMGM3MS1iZDMyLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=suuamc0ngr-isadSJCymZZsCQKkBbWzquGI9RLeH588=&emci=400d0acf-3631-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=74f10c71-bd32-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=26261389)Everyone having a voice at the ballot box is the foundation of our democracy.

3. **Congressional member stock trading.** Congressional members have access to insider information. **When members of Congress or their families use that information to make decisions about the stocks they own, they violate their sacred oath and undermine our democracy.** The American people are losing faith that our leaders are acting in the best interest of their communities, and rightly so. Earlier this year, [**I wrote an opinion piece about this issue and what I'm doing to stop it.** ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50591995/366460111/156764326?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NGYxMGM3MS1iZDMyLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=suuamc0ngr-isadSJCymZZsCQKkBbWzquGI9RLeH588=&emci=400d0acf-3631-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=74f10c71-bd32-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=26261389)

4. **Overturning of**** _Roe v. Wade_**. While the overwhelming majority of Americans support abortion rights, the disastrous _Dobbs_ decision ignored the people's will. **The right-wing Supreme Court's actions and the Senate's failure to pass reproductive health care protections have diminished the public's faith in our democracy.**[**Here are Politico's 20 ways America will change after the overturning of Roe v. Wade.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50591997/366460112/-253121584?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NGYxMGM3MS1iZDMyLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=suuamc0ngr-isadSJCymZZsCQKkBbWzquGI9RLeH588=&emci=400d0acf-3631-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=74f10c71-bd32-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=26261389)

5. **Dark money in politics**. So many of those first four issues have roots in the Supreme Court's 2010 _Citizens United_ decision which opened the door for special interests to flood our elections with dark money. **Politicians are beholden to these corporate interests instead of to the people.** In a functioning democracy, elected officials serve the interests of their constituents, not their donors. [**Learn more about the**** _Citizen's United_****decision here.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50591998/366460113/-2084407897?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NGYxMGM3MS1iZDMyLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=suuamc0ngr-isadSJCymZZsCQKkBbWzquGI9RLeH588=&emci=400d0acf-3631-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=74f10c71-bd32-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=26261389)

**Our democracy is under attack, but I haven't lost hope, and I'm not alone; in just the past couple of months, from coast to coast, we've seen the will of the people triumph at the ballot box over powerful special interests.** How? We've gone back to the basics. Our country was founded on the principle that government only works when we all have a say – when we build a community founded on trust. When folks have good information and a belief in the importance of our democracy, there's _nothing_ we can't accomplish. [**That's why my team and I are bringing supporters like you together to build the biggest grassroots movement New Jersey has ever seen, We've put together a page outlining lots of ways you can join us and take action in person and online. Please head on over and get clean_body: | | | | These are trying times. Our democracy is threatened from many directions, and it can feel overwhelming. As Election Day gets closer, we're seeing more and bolder attacks on voting rights. But we're also seeing unprecedented efforts to protect our democratic institutions and safeguard the will of the people. Here are five threats to our democracy and one thing we can do about it: 1. The Big Lie. Donald Trump's rhetoric leading up to the January 6 insurrection resulted in the deadliest attack on the Capitol since 1814. And while the events of that day could have brought our nation together, dozens of Republican candidates have doubled down on the lies; this year, more than half of all Americans will have a ballot with an election denier on it. 2. Attacks on voting rights. Over the last decade, anti-democratic radicals have systematically dismantled the Voting Rights Act of 1965. As of today,19 states have passed laws that make it more difficult, particularly for people of color and economically disadvantaged communities, to vote. having a voice at the ballot box is the foundation of our democracy. 3. Congressional member stock trading. Congressional members have access to insider information. When members of Congress or their families use that information to make decisions about the stocks they own, they violate their sacred oath and undermine our democracy. The American people are losing faith that our leaders are acting in the best interest of their communities, and rightly so. Earlier this year, 4. Overturning of Roe v. Wade. While the overwhelming majority of Americans support abortion rights, the disastrous Dobbs decision ignored the people's will. The right-wing Supreme Court's actions and the Senate's failure to pass reproductive health care protections have diminished the public's faith in our democracy. 5. Dark money in politics. So many of those first four issues have roots in the Supreme Court's 2010 Citizens United decision which opened the door for special interests to flood our elections with dark money. Politicians are beholden to these corporate interests instead of to the people. In a functioning democracy, elected officials serve the interests of their constituents, not their donors. Our democracy is under attack, but I haven't lost hope, and I'm not alone; in just the past couple of months, from coast to coast, we've seen the will of the people triumph at the ballot box over powerful special interests. How? We've gone back to the basics. Our country was founded on the principle that government only works when we all have a say – when we build a community founded on trust. When folks have good information and a belief in the importance of our democracy, there's nothing we can't accomplish. I’m running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

Now, I need _your_ help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.

It’s time for a _**change**_ in D.C., and I’m the right person for the job.

Hey Peter,
When I founded Andy’s Fight, I promised an unconventional approach to taking on the politicians opposed to sensible gun legislation and social media reform. Well, I’ve got a couple of big news items to report. In a previous email, I shared the story of the billboard I did when Ted Nugent came to Roanoke a few years ago and my plans to revisit and implement that strategy for races across the country.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95557/images/Good%20Billboard%20V4.png]
I’m keeping that promise. The first billboard is up and running and features a national disgrace—Congressman Bob Good. For those not familiar with this guy, he’s the Marjorie Taylor Greene of Virginia— maybe even worse, if that’s possible. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/08/16/us/politics/lgbt-bob-good-congress-va.html]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95557/images/IMG_0170.jpg]
This is just the start. You’ll see more like this across the country as Andy’s Fight trolls the bad guys. Here's a link to the video I made in front of the billboard the day it went up:
https://youtu.be/BZVP70myV0A [https://youtu.be/BZVP70myV0A]
The second piece of news is that I’m taking Andy’s Fight on the road to support candidates who believe in our cause—to advance common sense gun legislation and to reign in the abuse proliferating on social media. The mass shooting and live-streaming in Memphis is the latest example of what must be fixed. In a horrible irony, one of the victims was also named Alison Parker. [https://www.fox13memphis.com/news/local/west-memphis-remembers-allison-parker-nurse-who-died-memphis-shooting-spree/BDBTBVKMSNCIDHR7FEAVPXY4IU/]
Maybe we'll come to your town. Or maybe you know someone who deserves their own billboard from Andy's Fight! Send me a quick reply here if you are interested to learn about our tour. I may not reply immediately, but I promise to respond as soon as I can.
And as always, donate on ActBlue [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/andy-s-fight-1] to support my effort and thank you to those who have already contributed!
Until next time,
Andy

name: Scott Gryder
subject: Gallup: 56% of Americans Struggling to Make Ends Meet
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SCOTT GRYDER FOR CONGRESS**
body:
| | |
---
| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Contact: Gabriella Shanahangabriella@scottgryder.com
---
Oswego, Ill. – Lauren Underwood, Nancy Pelosi, and Joe Biden are driving our country and our state into the ground with their out-of-touch agenda. A new Gallup survey shows that _56% of Americans are struggling in the face of skyrocketing inflation_ and rising costs. IL-14 Rep. Lauren Underwood and President Biden have made our lives more expensive and more difficult. They put their radical, high-tax agenda ahead of the hardworking people of Illinois. Every piece of bad legislation that Lauren Underwood has voted for, Joe Biden has signed into law, and the government has benefited while leaving hardworking Illinoisans left to pick up the pieces of their failed policies. Scott Gryder said: “We’re seeing record-high gas prices because Nancy Pelosi and Lauren Underwood bowed to the demands of climate groups who are attempting to force Americans into buying electric vehicles that only the wealthy can afford. Taxes are going up because the Democrats rammed legislation through Congress that hikes taxes on working families. Purchasing household essentials has never been so expensive because of the Democrat’s reckless agenda." He added: “On November 8, we will change who controls Washington, D.C. and restore common-sense governance that puts people first. It shouldn’t be a contest for families to choose between buying gas or a gallon of milk, and for too many that has become the reality under the Underwood-Pelosi agenda.”
---
| | **More about Scott:** Scott has a long history of leadership for the community he serves. Elected three times to the Kendall County Board, Scott currently serves as its Chairman. By being a common-sense, pragmatic conservative, Scott has worked to keep taxes low and supported responsible spending policies on the County Board. He will take the same approach to Congress. Scott grew up in Plano and has called Kendall County home for most of his life. A graduate of the University of Illinois with a degree in business administration, Scott successfully pursued his law degree at DePaul. He is an active member of the Federalist Society and is licensed to practice law in Illinois and the U.S. Northern District of Illinois. Scott and his wife live in Oswego with their daughter. Outside of politics, he is active with the Oswegoland Park Foundation Board, is a PrairieFest Sponsor, and serves on the Fox Valley Family YMCA Board. ###

Quite frankly, Derek, now we’re nervous. Oz is using the GOP’s ca$h advantage to spread baseless lies about John... and they’re getting away with it...
The only way to fight back is a **_BIG surge of grassroots fundraising_** so we can immediately ramp up our TV ads budget across PA more than ever before. 👇

| | | Friend,

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

| | Peter,

Tim Walz has no answer on our crime problem in Minnesota. [We do.](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=5f28895111&e=33b11688c1)

Peter,

**I cannot overstate the importance of the Senate race in Georgia.**

This is the country's closest and most competitive battle. In 2020, Democrats won the Senate majority because of runoff wins in Georgia, and we can't let that happen again. **The future of our nation will be decided by what happens in Georgia on November 8.**

In a moment, I am going to ask every American patriot - _no matter where you live_ - **[to get off the sidelines and support my conservative friend Herschel Walker.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61257077:6saHzKVNW:m:1:3339843426:D885E06E09845A7F9AB7C135DF697EF0:r)** But first, you need to know why your help is so critical, Peter.

* This race has been declared a "toss up," so it could go EITHER WAY. **[It's up to us to help Herschel move the needle even further to flip this seat back into Republican hands.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61257077:6saHzKVNW:m:1:3339843426:D885E06E09845A7F9AB7C135DF697EF0:r)**

This race will be over in less than 70 days. We won't get this time back, Peter, and we need to do everything possible to ensure we reclaim the Senate majority and get America back on track.

**[I'm asking you to step up with $25 or more to help Herschel WIN this seat and FLIP the Senate RED.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61257077:6saHzKVNW:m:1:3339843426:D885E06E09845A7F9AB7C135DF697EF0:r)**

**Can I count on you?**

Thank you,

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61257077:6saHzKVNW:m:1:3339843426:D885E06E09845A7F9AB7C135DF697EF0:r)

Nikki Haley

P.S. We only need to flip one seat to end the Democrats' razor-thin majority. Herschel Walker will be our 51st Republican senator, but it will only happen if conservatives across the nation get off the sidelines and join his fight today. **[I'm ALL-IN for Herschel. 3. We continue to have a difficult time keeping our ADS fully funded due to our difficulty with online donations

4. It costs $7k to air one of my ads on TV per day. Every day we’re not on TV, we will lose ground to my far-left opponent

With Republicans only needing 5 seats to capture the House, victory is within reach. But the fundraising gap between DEMS and REPUBS is bewildering.

**I’m asking you to help ensure my ADS don’t have to come down next week. Any gift you’re able to make today.**

**Last month, The Cook Political Report upgraded the race in Oregon’s 4th District from “Solid Democrat” to “Lean Democrat.” That means that all of the resources we’ve put into this race, both in 2021 and now this year, are having their intended effect.**

If we are forced to pull our ADS off TV for even one day, **we cede ground to the Democrats we may not get back.**

Friend -- we’ve reached a point where some are openly pledging to cause chaos at the polls.

**If their strategy throws just a few hundred votes into dispute at a few polling locations in these midterm elections, it could have huge implications for state legislative and congressional majorities ahead of the 2024 elections.**

These threats didn’t prompt us to pivot from redistricting work to democracy work -- redistricting work is democracy work. Without fair elections, fair maps won’t deliver the progress the people have demanded and deserve.

Our comprehensive state-by-state approach proved its effectiveness during redistricting because of supporters like you.

body:
From rural to urban and East to West, I’ve hit the campaign trail almost every week to let communities know that they aren’t getting left behind.

Derek, I’ve made it my priority to travel across Pennsylvania and meet with folks from all walks of life. From rural to urban and East to West, I’ve hit the campaign trail almost every week to let communities know that they aren’t getting left behind. ****[Pennsylvania’s a pretty big state, and it takes a lot of resources to get around — that’s why I’m asking right now if you can chip in to fuel this campaign’s efforts to meet with voters?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50601555/366480113/-1807903084?refcode=email_091222_pastories_FULLLIST&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=831c2819-cd32-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MzFjMjgxOS1jZDMyLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PHfAsUfY3jn6-456xI54Yoek_GUD3Bmx8_SiAuRVqxc=)**** When I show up in those communities, Derek, I listen. I’ve listened to the moms in Erie standing next to their minivans, telling me about how rising costs were making them wonder whether or not they were going to be able to take their kids to the activities that they wanted to go to. I talked to the mom in a rural community living right next to a polluted area, worried that when she bathed her child that the water coming out of the tap wasn’t clean. I listened to people in communities that oftentimes felt ignored and forgotten. The person who called the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania when the pandemic hit and they lost their job, and couldn't even get their calls returned. I stood alongside the grandma in Lawrence County, who literally grabbed me by the lapels and pulled me into her face and said do not let us go back to what it was like before Roe. The countless people who have stopped me along the way and just wondered whether or not our democracy was going to get through this. I have listened and I have heard those concerns, and I'm running to be your Governor not just to win an election, but to address those worries and to move Pennsylvania forward. With just 57 days to go until November 8th, the polls are still showing that this is a nearly tied race. Because even though Doug Mastriano is as extreme as they get — he’s a literal insurrectionist who wants to ban all abortion with no exceptions — he has an army of grassroots supporters trying to elect him. But Mastriano’s vision for Pennsylvania cannot come to pass. Instead, I’m focused on helping Pennsylvanians work with dignity for a liveable wage, defending a woman’s right to choose, and ensuring we all have access to the ballot box. That’s what I’ve been fighting for my whole career — and especially in this Governor’s race. **[That's why I'm running to be your Governor. We have a lot of work to do, but first we need to win this election so that we can do that work. Derek, I’ve made it my priority to travel across Pennsylvania and meet with folks from all walks of life. From rural to urban and East to West, I’ve hit the campaign trail almost every week to let communities know that they aren’t getting left behind. **= When I show up in those communities, Derek, I listen. I’ve listened to the moms in Erie standing next to their minivans, telling me about how rising costs were making them wonder whether or not they were going to be able to take their kids to the activities that they wanted to go to. I talked to the mom in a rural community living right next to a polluted area, worried that when she bathed her child that the water coming out of the tap wasn’t clean. I listened to people in communities that oftentimes felt ignored and forgotten. The person who called the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania when the pandemic hit and they lost their job, and couldn't even get their calls returned. I stood alongside the grandma in Lawrence County, who literally grabbed me by the lapels and pulled me into her face and said do not let us go back to what it was like before Roe. The countless people who have stopped me along the way and just wondered whether or not our democracy was going to get through this. I have listened and I have heard those concerns, and I'm running to be your Governor not just to win an election, but to address those worries and to move Pennsylvania forward. With just 57 days to go until November 8th, the polls are still showing that this is a nearly tied race. Because even though Doug Mastriano is as extreme as they get — he’s a literal insurrectionist who wants to ban all abortion with no exceptions — he has an army of grassroots supporters trying to elect him. Derek, right now, abortion is still legal in Pennsylvania — but the next Governor will decide if it stays that way.
I have always fought for a woman’s right to choose, from my time as state Representative to now, as your Attorney General. A woman’s power over her own body should not be up for discussion by politicians — or by anyone.
That is why I will veto any legislation that attempts to further restrict abortion rights and reproductive health in Pennsylvania.
Derek , throughout my time in public service I’ve always defended women’s rights. If I am elected Governor, I will veto any bill trying to infringe on women’s rights. Could you split a donation between our campaign can CommonGood today to protect the freedom to choose in Pennsylvania and across our country? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_js?refcode=20220912_CGVA_JS]

body:

---
For the call to action this week, we are asking you to repeat action items that are still active. The ones we have listed this week are not only important issues on which we want to affect the outcome, but are also helpful in our efforts to elect a new Congress in November. The ones we are asking you to do again are the ones we believe will help drive turnout – **_which is why we are also asking you to share these action items as much as you can this week_** _._ Sharing these action items will help turnout in November in addition to building pressure on the issues themselves, so please, please make sharing these action items a priority this week (and going forward through the election)!
---
| | |
---
[](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
---
**Election Workers Still Needed!** As you may know, the main focus of Tea Party Patriots Action since the 2020 election has been election integrity. **Much of election integrity depends on honest patriots like you signing up as poll workers and poll watchers.** In nearly every county in the U.S., most these positions have historically been held by left-wing activists. If we are not a part of the process, we cannot ensure there is honesty and integrity in the system. If you’re wondering which is better, poll worker (also called election worker, officer of election, election judge, etc. in different places) is preferable. Poll watchers are much more limited in what they are able to do, while workers have actual power to make decisions that matter, in most cases. And they get paid a lot of the time! So, if you have a choice, it is better to be a worker than a watcher, but being a watcher is better than nothing! The [**U.S. Election Assistance Commission has a handy tool**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyNTUtNjU3NjY1ZWQ3NjY0NDYwNDk2OWQ1YmNiZDE2YjllN2UiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMSIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmVhYy5nb3YvaGVscC1hbWVyaWNhLXZvdGU_bWlkPTQ1NzgyJmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/YOgvvhj0pxjSx84mYs7nSA) to find out how to sign up. Just scroll down to the **Poll Worker Recruitment Lookup Tool** and select your state. They also have [**a document that lists all of the requirements for serving as a poll worker**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) on a state-by-state basis, so you can use that to see if you meet the requirements. Additionally, if you are interested in helping us build permanent election integrity infrastructure in your state and in your county, [please fill out this form](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyNTUtNjU3NjY1ZWQ3NjY0NDYwNDk2OWQ1YmNiZDE2YjllN2UiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMyIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LnRlYXBhcnR5cGF0cmlvdHMub3JnL2VpYy8_bWlkPTQ1NzgyJmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/QQ3dHw4VH9Vhp2aXPVNyQA), and we will be in touch with you. **Get Out The Vote Volunteer Sign-up!** [**Please fill out this form**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) to let us know which activities you’d be interested in doing. If you’re not sure you want to volunteer, think about the countless ways in which the White House and the various federal agencies are out of control and targeting innocent Americans who disagree with them. There will be no end to this targeting and corruption, and no one will pay for what they have done, if we do not elect a new Congress. The GOTV activities we have planned are very easy to do and won’t take up a ton of your time. It will be worth it, believe me. Please [**fill out the form**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) today!

Dear Friend, **There is a war on women taking place in this country right at this moment.** For decades, women have fought for their right to equal opportunities in academics and athletics. But in its push to radically redefine the previously undisputed definitions of "man" and "woman," the Left is depriving women of some of their hard-won civil rights gains. Thanks to the current anti-scientific gender identity movement that the far Left is forcing onto our society, biological male athletes who self-identify as women are being allowed to compete in women's athletic competitions. In one prominent example, the NCAA has allowed a biological male swimmer--now going by the name Lia Thomas--to compete in women's competitions, outracing all the biological female competitors at the NCAA women's 500-yard freestyle national championship meet. Far from being the only case of females being bumped off victor podiums by biological males, the Lia Thomas story shines a light on a disturbing cultural trend increasingly permeating women's sports. You and I both know that sex is an immutable biological reality. We must uphold the scientific and biblical meaning of the words "man" and "woman." In doing so, we will protect female athletes from the injustice of being completely driven out of their sports by biological males. Friend, if you agree that biological males should stay out of women's sports**,****[show your support for women athletes by signing the NATIONAL PETITION right now--there is no time to waste.](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zq739d7jrrke17p4huo8q840lrfjai3620l35b40_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1i6cp30cph2bs) **

---
| | By allowing biological males to dominate women's athletic competitions, the NCAA has perpetrated an attack on women's and girls' athletic opportunities. This grave injustice is wildly unpopular amongst rational members of society... _yet_ most people are too afraid to speak out against it out of fear of extreme social criticism or political backlash. **One collegiate female athlete said that Thomas ' participation in women**'**s swimming has completely ruined the integrity of the sport, and she finds it disappointing to know that the NCAA lacks the courage to do the right thing.** Title IX prohibits any school that receives federal funding from discriminating on the basis of sex. But instead of ensuring equal treatment of the sexes in all areas--including athletics--some schools are allowing athletes to compete based on what gender they self-identify with. Such a policy undermines the purpose of Title IX. **More importantly, it undermines the American way of life and the principles we stand for --we can't allow it to continue. ** [**Click here to sign the National Petition to STOP BIOLOGICAL MALES FROM COMPETING IN WOMEN 'S SPORTS.**](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2ze53ne7lqdpn1joqss7nr5hdldqjc04f1e5ie3r0_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1i6cp30cph2bs)

Please sign Family Research Council Action** '**s national petition right away to block men from competing in female sports.**](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zk47p2h7nblavf9pk82ac204ftbthi2h4cd3nm00_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1i6cp30cph2bs)

body:

| |
---
I'll keep this short, team. In case you didn't know, we're quickly approaching our **last** end-of-quarter deadline before the November midterm elections. I'm going to break down exactly why this milestone is the most important one we need to prepare for yet. [__**But first, will you chip in $5 or more to help make sure we blow our end-of-quarter goal out of the water? →**__](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50605245/366496713/386834152?refcode2=3882f066-d832-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&amount=5&refcode=220912_rs_eoqexplainer_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85MzY4MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzODgyZjA2Ni1kODMyLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9NRtUXP6J1olvldZUfRTKFzTPF_9wilXq7r3PPt75LE=) This last FEC filing deadline means that my team and I have to submit a campaign finance report. The report is public, which also means that it's a huge opportunity for Eric to head into the final weeks before the election as a strong, winning candidate. **But if we miss our fundraising target, it will decrease the number of voters that we’re able to connect with before Election Day.** This is our last quarterly deadline to show the GOP, Anna Paulina Luna, and her special interest groups that Eric and the Democrats are going to win this race and keep Pinellas blue! name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=1ca532218eed40d0915de9b893ecb89e&_e=-1zvVA5iobEzfXiDJ66_dPy9MFxM2rOss-t1wBRJrXl2MmneHOqYy8uGzLMK01aO4oL7dP29tTabbmvf5vbjYLZI0yZ3xQtll2Noqh9fnnk3esKW-fsCrZAH-xPvIsl2D1OVZv33bn_ZwHtP6-zWddk1hOg4dV0fxKjvRFW-ZK0ZbDtAR5FoHhLH13blrEDwtJCPh_j4p9EkGnwxbmnIkPP9OxDgklwoqvVX99_bL7p4qtODdqI1uHHvNqmQI9JSruXeDx9ecJxhDovtYU2nxDNswHOYwxw-2NAP1_rg3ZS5g7fxizloBawLKsvXJNonIVORS4TnJg3hKDVs_xfjkMPgCnkiQOBlpPrLYm1AK-QsRzES20OLwr5k87seUdtKK9jlFY4-yHVZFADCbnh0Eg%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=1ca532218eed40d0915de9b893ecb89e&_e=-1zvVA5iobEzfXiDJ66_dPy9MFxM2rOss-t1wBRJrXl2MmneHOqYy8uGzLMK01aO4oL7dP29tTabbmvf5vbjYLZI0yZ3xQtll2Noqh9fnnk3esKW-fsCrZAH-xPvIsl2D1OVZv33bn_ZwHtP6-zWddk1hOg4dV0fxKjvRFW-ZK0ZbDtAR5FoHhLH13blrEDwtJCPh_j4p9EkGnwxbmnIkPP9OxDgklwoqvVX99_bL7oA0703-LS_vSZvgkx_mmm1QcDzFBCcEiuCDGzc-JYKuV9XK5Vh5yJ7IJ2Pg33U4uUwXfYVy2T-IfFBFkIBluFAZVjbYtOidCtR03Sow3C84V45k6DK7bQ9jTxr7dbMCG6X88adCwcmV_OY4oD6NR3nZ5q9I_x3b6bR7Xv9Hv2G7w%3D%3D)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=1ca532218eed40d0915de9b893ecb89e&_e=-1zvVA5iobEzfXiDJ66_dPy9MFxM2rOss-t1wBRJrXl2MmneHOqYy8uGzLMK01aO4oL7dP29tTabbmvf5vbjYLZI0yZ3xQtll2Noqh9fnnk3esKW-fsCrZAH-xPvIsl2D1OVZv33bn_ZwHtP6-zWddk1hOg4dV0fxKjvRFW-ZK0ZbDtAR5FoHhLH13blrEDwtJCPh_j4p9EkGnwxbmnIkPP9OxDgklwoqvVX99_bL7rYFHzBL0os7sewlFG6VAj0hkIF7AMgY-mW7FT7VSCZbTFHbcBBUd_30dJBYxl--Bq8EHf8figMz_nG0TbphZvBeHwCbdBtEhRuH8Q1-GOqya1kv0PNV16KA8RcZDJhNPx-7AaXBKU0MPQ5y9PuWmTk2fdQUq7LtfFTs-iXkjh04w%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

body:
Jim Jordan continues to prove he’s not the right leader for Ohioans.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50607344/366505726/-849735382?refcode=EM_FR_220912RealAmerica_JimJordan_SB_90DO_7_NG_TESTA_logo&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZmNkMGE3YS1lMTMyLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z__JivztL3VWgcSqnjhoVtNZAvOCb2lAh1X0asIB30E=) We shouldn’t be surprised by Jim Jordan’s divisive language, Peter. But just last week, he took to Twitter to prove once again just how out of touch he is with Ohio.

Jim Jordan described what he believes “Real America” is – where according to him, you “work hard, pay your bills, and provide for your family.” And according to him, President Biden and Democrats don’t represent Real America with our policies. All this comes in the wake of President Biden promising to help Americans by canceling up to $20,000 worth of student loans for those who need it most.

**It’s clearer than ever:** What Jim Jordan is really trying to say is that any American in need of help should be left behind by our government, not taken care of.

[**_We’re calling on Ohioans everywhere to step up today and show Jim Jordan we don’t agree with his backward thinking. Will you pitch in $5 to make sure Republicans like Jim Jordan can’t expand their influence in Ohio one bit this November?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50607345/366505727/-849735382?refcode=EM_FR_220912RealAmerica_JimJordan_SB_90DO_7_NG_TESTA_l1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZmNkMGE3YS1lMTMyLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z__JivztL3VWgcSqnjhoVtNZAvOCb2lAh1X0asIB30E=)

Peter, elected officials are selected to be the voice their neighbors and constituents deserve, to help build up our communities so that we may all thrive.

But according to Jim Jordan, unless you fall in line with his idea of Real America, you won’t be getting his help at all. It’s shameful, it’s despicable, and we can’t let him get away with his backward thinking.
