Friend: With less than 60 days until Election Day, I'm going to ask you to make a contribution to flip Georgia blue and take back the Senate. **But first, I'd like to explain why I'm running – and why I need your urgent support to win.**
**I'll be honest: People like me aren't supposed to run for office.** I grew up in public housing in Savannah, Georgia, and I had 11 brothers and sisters. We were short on money but long on love and faith. From there, I became the first in our family to graduate from a four-year college, I earned a Ph.D., and 15 years ago, I was called to Martin Luther King Jr.'s pulpit to serve as the senior pastor of Ebenezer Baptist Church.
As a pastor, I always thought my impact doesn't stop at the church door – that's where it starts. I've been a lifelong advocate for affordable health care, fair wages, and voting rights. Now, I'm running for reelection to continue bringing these critical fights to Washington.
Listen, friend: The opportunities that made my journey possible, from Kayton Homes to Dr. King's pulpit, are growing further and further out of reach for far too many across this country. subject: Are You on Biden's New List of Extremists?
body:
**[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61264329:6hCRXKVvN:m:1:3253819041:BDE3C24756D0D51513F4217D55B73B17:r)**

Peter, are you on Biden's new list of EXTREMISTS?
Do you support my Freedom Agenda? If so, Biden thinks you are an extremist because you supported me as we:
* Fought the COVID lockdowns, mask requirements, and vaccine mandates.
* Fought for parents who want their children educated, not indoctrinated.
* Fought for election integrity and banned Zuckerbucks.
* Continue to fight FOR THE PEOPLE and against the fake news and big government elites who try to keep us down.

I guess that makes us "extremists" in the eyes of the most unpopular president in history.

I know I'm in good company alongside conservative Americans like you who have been repeatedly villainized by the liberal elite.

We're all just trying to work hard, raise our kids, and make a better life for the next generation.

In Florida, we're still free to do that.

That will always be true, as long as I am Governor. And Peter, **__[I need your help today to Keep Florida Free.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61264329:6hCRXKVvN:m:1:3253819041:BDE3C24756D0D51513F4217D55B73B17:r)__**

**_[KEEP FLORIDA FREE: $100](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61264329:6hCRXKVvN:m:1:3253819041:BDE3C24756D0D51513F4217D55B73B17:r)_**
**_[KEEP FLORIDA FREE: $75](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61264329:6hCRXKVvN:m:1:3253819041:BDE3C24756D0D51513F4217D55B73B17:r)_**

Right now, we face a very serious threat from far-Left Biden sycophants like Charlie Crist.

Crist doesn't only support Biden's anti-conservative rhetoric, he parrots it!

In a recent press conference, he told reporters that he would never want the support from my supporters because he thinks we have "hate in our hearts."

Charlie Crist loves Joe Biden's unhinged attacks on the American people, but he thinks YOU are hateful.

This disgusting rhetoric that sets half of the country against the other half of the country is nothing but a desperate attempt to distract from the failing, leftist policies destroying much of this nation.

Biden and Crist both hope that their hateful speech against YOU will energize their liberal base enough to help them fend off a HUGE loss they fully deserve this November.

But I don't think they stand a chance.

If the "extremists" like you and me stand together now to continue our fight for common sense and liberty, we will prevail.

That's why I need you to **__[chip in now to support so-called"EXTREMIST" freedom.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61264329:6hCRXKVvN:m:1:3253819041:BDE3C24756D0D51513F4217D55B73B17:r)__**

Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0lr5c66pmir1p8rb0qm9l2qaf22c083o0cph9kg_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1i69p34cdh2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z6loahmjj4h8hvkgsq22fvnlouk1r6k75noaa3k8_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1i69p34cdh2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

I knew this race was important from the very beginning. That’s why I endorsed Matt Mowers last year and have been rallying behind him ever since. NH-01 is a battleground district for Republicans. It’s one of the 5 seats we must flip to take back the House majority — and we can do it. But it won’t be easy. This is a TOSS UP race. In 2020, Democrat Chris Pappas won NH-01 by just 5 points. Of the past 10 elections for this seat, Republicans have won nearly half. Electing Republican Matt Mowers tomorrow is the first critical step to winning in November. So if you have anything to spare, I’m humbly asking you to pitch in to Matt Mowers’ campaign today, before it’s too late. My very best,

**Exclusive Message from Nikki** When I was growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys Club and my opponent thought that women didn’t belong in politics. People thought I was too brown...too female...too young...too conservative...too principled... Well, I said: Too bad!** ** I was inspired by great women who broke barriers and defied expectations, women like Margaret Thatcher and Jeane Kirkpatrick. **Today, shares trade under $3.15! This means the price would have TO DOUBLE, just to go back to par.**

On top of that, H.C. just issued a price target of $8.50, implying a 240% upside from here in the next 12 months!

**Royalty and streaming is an entirely different way of capturing the upside of mining activity, and in many ways, it 's a de-risked form of exposure.**

First and foremost, a couple of definitions to get you started. "Royalties" are basically just a payment to a royalty holder by a property owner or project operator. Royalties are typically based on a percentage of the minerals produced and the revenues or profits generated from the property.

Royalty companies don't have to mine for the gold themselves - they can instead fund the best projects available, let other companies do the legwork, and potentially profit from the gold discoveries.

**It 's a highly compelling business model, with distinct advantages. With royalty companies, you get exposure (often magnified) to commodity prices, fixed operating costs, no development or sustaining capital costs, exploration and expansion upside without the overhead typically associated with those activities, a diversified asset portfolio, and the ability to grow without a major increase in management.**

Royalties are non-operating interests in the underlying project, so the holder is generally not responsible for contributing additional funds for any purpose, including capital and operating costs.

**Royalties generally limit the holder 's exposure to exploration, development, operating, sustaining, or reclamation expenditures typically associated with an operating interest in a mine.**
**If Gold Roylaty Corp. (NYSE: GROY) received the same valuation metrics as its peers, its price would be double or triple today 's! While they have limited operating exposure, royalty and stream holders do benefit from any resource expansion or upside generated by exploration success, mine life extensions, and operational expansions within the areas covered by the interest.**

A royalty and streaming business model provides greater diversification than typical mining companies. These companies typically hold a portfolio of diversified assets, while mining companies generally depend on one or a few key mines.

**Besides, building a mine is very capital-intensive. A mining company could finance a mine construction by issuing shares, but the investors might not like this because it could cause the company 's shares to be diluted.**

A royalty arrangement can eliminate the potential for share dilution while funding value-added projects. So, the benefits to the mining company are evident.

**It 's a business model that allows the company to potentially generate revenues whether the gold price is rising or falling since royalty companies set fixed prices for mining output. As a result, it's actually not unusual for the royalty names to outperform both the price of gold and gold miners.**

Moreover, royalty companies typically hold highly diversified portfolios, so this reduces concentration risk. If one of the properties stops producing precious metals, the royalty companies can lean on other producers. So, by owning shares in a royalty company, investors have exposure to a number of different companies.

**Royalty and streaming companies generally offer a relatively lower-risk investment when compared to operating companies while still offering potential upside to resource expansion and underlying commodity prices.**

My friends - I am so blessed to have your support. The feedback I am getting on the campaign trail is absolutely incredible! Every diner we go to, every door we knock on, and every small business we visit – Granite Staters are telling us that they want someone new and that **IT IS TIME for a new generation of conservatives** in Washington!

Our economy is hanging by a thread thanks to the policies of the Biden Regime . . . and it's about to get worse!

Biden's Federal Trade Commission is attempting to force through a rule change that will WRECK the car buying industry and I need your help now to stop it!

[Sign here to Tell the FTC "NO" on new regulation that will stall car sales throughout America!](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/C9nTnxq4lke1E4la0LQd5g/ZIfN3fRy892q9cvbZceLOXAA)

Today, the FTC is proposing the opposite, which would drastically reduce new car and truck sales when new models are already hard to find.

Congressman Dr. Paul Gosar Endorsed our Campaign | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/98e70de5dcac/we-need-more-veterans-in-the-house-do-you-agree-15891929?e=3cd8121505)

#
**My Fellow Patriot,**
**Congressman Dr. Paul Gosar, Arizona’s ICONIC America First Patriot, has ENDORSED our campaign to win back Virginia’s Fourth Congressional District and our effort to #SaveAmerica! He knows me; he knows I have what it takes to WIN!** **Congressman Gosar is an inspiration to America First Conservatives like myself. When everyone is afraid to speak on an issue, he does. When the Washington Establishment says to be silent, he speaks even louder. He is the leadership we NEED in Congress. ** **Congressman Gosar is a fighter, and so am I. He defeated the odds, overcame cook rating, and WON! He and I have something in common, we both know this race, and we know how to WIN. His endorsement is one I’m honored to have!**
**[JOIN REP. GOSAR IN SUPPORTING MY RACE!](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=d5f2c2b05f&e=3cd8121505) **
**As a Navy Combat Veteran, I served this country and the American people. Now I’m running for Congress as the GOP Nominee for VA-4 to serve again!** **While the Left works to destroy our free speech, right to bear arms, and civil liberties, I’m organizing a grassroots campaign team like NEVER SEEN BEFORE. Congressman Gosar is doing an impeccable job in office, fighting against critical race theory, fighting against the vaccine mandates, and protecting parental rights. In Congress, I’ll continue his efforts nationwide and ensure our efforts to serve Virginians best are a TOP priority.**
**The Left is SCARED and is pumping dark money into my opponent's campaign. LIKE CRAZY! I need your help; I need reinforcements. I’m tired of We The People being neglected by those in office with the privilege of serving us. They have a sense of political entitlement that is truly sick and wrong.** **[HELP LEON TAKE BACK AMERICA!](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=03d09fd969&e=3cd8121505) **

**My name is Leon Benjamin, and I’m running for Congress as a Conservative Republican... because I’m sick of what the far Left has done to my community and to American families. I’m a husband, father, and pastor. I owe it to my congregation and my family to build a better future. These days we need to fight for them even to have a future.**
[**Help me beat the special interests, the Soros money, and WIN- $50, $150, $250!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=47ddae327e&e=3cd8121505)
**I didn't serve this country to see it burned to the ground by BLM anarchists or tassel loafer-wearing government bureaucrats. I served to defend our constitution. Defend our liberties. Defend our people, or die trying.**
[**HELP LEON SERVE THE PEOPLE!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=6841a88a4a&e=3cd8121505) **We are weeks away from Early voting and need to come up with $10,000 for a final mailer. Will you chip in at this CRITICAL time?** [**DONATE NOW!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=77edcc2ba9&e=3cd8121505) [**$25**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=4d3c7b7102&e=3cd8121505) [**$50**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=7b75e8b683&e=3cd8121505) [**$75**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=4e9ac60650&e=3cd8121505) [**$100**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=7c404c764d&e=3cd8121505)

**God bless you, your families, and God bless America. The country we know, love, and must protect. ** **Your Friend in Christ,**

Leon Benjamin [****](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=d1295d72a6&e=3cd8121505)

Team,
Back in 2020, when campaigning as we know it was upended by COVID, we figured out a way to still have energetic, in-person events while still maintaining COVID safety guidelines.
My district is home to quite a few small communities with some beautiful parks. And as such, what we affectionately referred to as our “Gazebo Tour” was born!
Well, this year we’ve brought the Gazebo Tour back in a way, and we called it Summer in the Seventh... and stay tuned for the next chapter, September in the Seventh! Big crowds have joined us at each event from across the 7th district, especially in the new counties.

body:
It’s time to activate Gen Z

| [ ](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=BJAgHetUUIqrbBbKj3z09j9OpIZbBzc5g2-7VwfHf34&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=our_future_v1&n=1)
---
Friend, I need your help. Classes for UW students started last week, and it is becoming more clear every year that the left is tightening its grip on young, impressionable students. My peers and I are fighting for conservative values on campus, but we’re met with backlash at every turn. | [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDV-nogt4O0Ur7M8C0g0r-SrhGzfZPYzWeFkufgjik0cVo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=our_future_v1&n=2 "$5 to Save Gen Z") [$5 to Save Gen Z](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDV-nogt4O0Ur7M8C0g0r-SrhGzfZPYzWeFkufgjik0cVo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=our_future_v1&n=2)

[**_With your help, we can continue to have a lasting impact on our campus communities._**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDV-nogt4O0Ur7M8C0g0r-SrrWJ4PfRomtcBc7BFt0-ps8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=our_future_v1&n=8)

With every door knocked and every student talked to, we come just a tad closer to loosening the left’s grip on college campuses. We just need your help.
[**_Would you please consider chipping in to help elect leaders who will support us? Just $5 would be so appreciated by my peers and me._**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDV-nogt4O0Ur7M8C0g0r-SrhGzfZPYzWeFkufgjik0cVo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=our_future_v1&n=10)
Thank you for your support,
Ali B - College Republican

_Content warning: mentions of assault_ Friend, my mom was 15-years-old when she was sexually assaulted and became pregnant. Access to abortion saved her life. Fifteen years later my mom had completed her education, married, and was ready to start a family. That’s where I come in ❤️ I wouldn’t be here writing to you today if my mom hadn’t had access to safe and legal abortion care. I’m thankful that she had the opportunity to make her own choice, and that she is open to sharing her story with other young women like me so that we know _**our bodies and our futures are ours.**_ I’m extremely scared of what the future holds for the next 15-year old girl who becomes pregnant. With the Supreme Court decision, her rights are completely dependent on what state she lives in. Republicans in Congress have already put forward legislation that would ban abortion with no exceptions. **The GOP is now just 5 seats shy of getting the House Majority and having the votes to pass their nationwide abortion ban.** I’m managing Dr. Kermit’s campaign because I know from personal experience what’s at stake this November. HEADLINES: Fighting Manchin’s Dirty Deal | Swing State Fund! | MIDTERMS
BLUEPRINT! | Rhode Island Votes Tues | St. Louis Votes Tues | & MORE!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7582?t=1013&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ][IMG]

Our Revolution is leading the charge alongside frontline communities and
environmental justice groups like Greenpeace to kill Joe Manchin’s side deal for
more dirty oil favors.

Manchin is willing to shut down the government for more fossil fuel projects
like the Mountain Valley Pipeline in WV and strip safeguards from impacted
communities.

Dems can’t celebrate “the biggest climate steps in history” while reversing them
by caving to a literal coal baron.

Our coalition of 650 organizations is urging Senate Majority Leader Chuck
Schumer to detach the deal from the must-pass bill to fund the government — we
cannot let Manchin hold us hostage!

Bernie railed against it on the Senate floor this week and says he’ll vote it
down, and Our Revolution is calling for a progressive mutiny in Congress.

A coalition of 72 US House Reps have signed onto a [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7584?t=1014&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ]letter led by US Rep. Raul
Grijalva - but we need more of our representatives in Congress to stand in
opposition.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7585?t=1015&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ]CALL YOUR HOUSE REP

* Don’t fast-track new gas or oil projects
* Don’t fast-track carbon pipelines
* Don’t cut safeguards for impacted communities
* Separate the deal from the must-pass bill to fund the government
* Sign US Rep. Grijalva’s letter

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7582?t=1016&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ][IMG]

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7582?t=1017&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ][IMG]

Our Revolution has a blueprint for the Midterms, and we’ve launched our Swing
State Fund to power our GOTV machine and mobilize millions of voters in
November.

This election is an opportunity to sink or swim — descend into a rightwing
extremist nightmare — OR — fight like hell to build on our work and progress.

We have a plan to defeat the far right and flip senate seats in Pennsylvania and
Wisconsin by electing progressives like John Fetterman and Mandela Barnes. Let’s
grow our power to cancel out Manchin and Sinema.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7582?t=1018&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ][IMG]

With a goal of $300,000 for our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7593?t=1019&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ]Swing State Fund — $200K in PA and $100K in
WI — we can reach half a million voters and FLIP TWO SENATE SEATS.

Reaching these funding goals - or not - will determine if we get John Fetterman
or Dr. Oz and if Mandela Barnes replaces Ron Johnson in WI — if we cancel out
Manchin and Sinema or if we face a new MAGA majority.

The stakes couldn’t be higher, and there’s a real danger that many progressive,
working-class voters will not be motivated to turn out.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7593?t=1020&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ]DONATE TO OUR SWING STATE FUND

★ ★ ★

RHODE ISLAND VOTES TUESDAY

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7582?t=1021&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ][IMG]

Bernie has joined us in endorsing David Segal for US Congress in Rhode Island’s
2nd — and election day is this Tuesday!

“David is one of those leaders we need in Congress,” Bernie said. “As a
legislator and as a grassroots organizer, he has been a champion in taking on
corporate interests, breaking up big monopolies, and demanding that health be
considered as a human right, not a privilege.”

Last week, David joined Jane Fonda and US Rep. Ro Khanna in a conversation on
how we can achieve progressive policy.

He has been a longtime ally of Our Revolution as director of Demand Progress and
would make a valuable partner in Congress.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5385?t=1022&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ]Make calls for David this weekend!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7582?t=1023&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ][IMG]

We have a fantastic slate of progressives joining David on the ballot in Rhode
Island.

For State House, Giona Picheco is a Navy Veteran running on a platform of gun
safety, public schools, housing, and civil rights in the 14th District. And,
Former Woonsocket City Councilmember Alex Kithes (District 49) is a champion of
climate, gay rights, and racial justice.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7582?t=1024&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ][IMG]

A former Bernie delegate and former director of Black Lives Matter RI PAC, Corey
Jones will bring valuable grassroots perspective to Providence City Council in
Ward 3.

Jackie Goldman (Ward 5) is a public health researcher and member of the LGBT
community fighting for more low-income housing and transparency in government.

Miguel Sanchez (Ward 6) is a community advocate who has organized for Medicare
for All and a voice for marginalized groups.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7582?t=1025&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ][IMG]

Tuesday is also election day in St. Louis, and it’s time to vote for Megan Green
for President of the Board of Aldermen!

“If I win this race, I’ll be the link we need in St. Louis - progressives will
hold the power seats to move forward our agenda,” Megan told us on our recent
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6294?t=1026&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ]National Call.

Megan was a Bernie delegate in 2016 and we were proud to help elect her to the
board in St. Louis, where she’s fought for a higher minimum wage, reproductive
freedom, domestic violence protections, legal marijuana, and more.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6242?t=1027&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ]Make calls for Megan this weekend!

Thank you and Congrats to fast food workers in California, who fought and won AB
257 and a seat at the table!

And, thank you to all the Our Revolution activists who helped clinch this HUGE
win — sending a barrage of calls to state senators (flipping votes!), pressuring
Gov. Newsom, and amplifying workers’ voices in this fight!

This is a BIG deal! An industry-wide workers’ council in California is a step
toward sectoral bargaining, which means half a million fast food workers will
have a voice as a whole industry in the state.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7070?t=1034&akid=3382%2E5885482%2EhfyGlF ]We can use this as a template to empower workers in states across the

| Hey, team.

Since becoming Arizona’s Democratic nominee for Secretary of State, we’ve had a lot of new folks join our movement, so I wanted to take a moment to reintroduce myself.

You may know me as the election official who led the charge to prove Arizona’s 2020 elections were safe and secure, the former U.S. Marine Marksmanship Instructor who dismantled the right’s Second Amendment lies, or the candidate running against Oath Keeper and extremist Mark Finchem, but really, my story is simple.

**I’m a father, small-business owner, and concerned citizen for our democracy.**

**[I want to share more on why this race and our democracy are so important to me, but first, I have to ask: Will you join me in my fight to become Arizona’s next Secretary of State and protect our democracy by splitting a donation of $10 right now between me and the Arizona Democratic Party?

When I joined the U.S. Marines, _I took a sacred vow to support and defend the Constitution against all enemies, foreign and domestic._ I still hold that oath today in this campaign and the work I do every day.

In 2020, I had the honor to serve as Maricopa County Recorder, running the nation’s _3rd largest voting precinct._ As County Recorder, my work and the work of my bipartisan team stood up to one of the most extensive election audits we’ve ever seen. I dedicated myself to counting every single vote, even when the numbers began to show I’d lost my own race.

clean_body: | | | We’ve had a lot of new folks join, so I wanted to take a moment to reintroduce myself. | | | Hey, team. Since becoming Arizona’s Democratic nominee for Secretary of State, we’ve had a lot of new folks join our movement, so I wanted to take a moment to reintroduce myself. You may know me as the election official who led the charge to prove Arizona’s 2020 elections were safe and secure, the former U.S. Marine Marksmanship Instructor who dismantled the right’s Second Amendment lies, or the candidate running against Oath Keeper and extremist Mark Finchem, but really, my story is simple. I’m a father, small-business owner, and concerned citizen for our democracy. When I joined the U.S. Marines, I took a sacred vow to support and defend the Constitution against all enemies, foreign and domestic. I still hold that oath today in this campaign and the work I do every day. In 2020, I had the honor to serve as Maricopa County Recorder, running the nation’s 3rd largest voting precinct. As County Recorder, my work and the work of my bipartisan team stood up to one of the most extensive election audits we’ve ever seen. I dedicated myself to counting every single vote, even when the numbers began to show I’d lost my own race. Team, I have to be honest with you. I’m running for Arizona’s Secretary of State because the November midterms could be our nation’s last truly democratic election. With extremists like Donald Trump, Mark Finchem, and so many more working to dismantle our elections from the inside, we must not relent. Democracy needs us. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: We won student debt relief, but…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
The Republicans know how big this victory is.
#
Peter,
Thanks to the tireless advocacy of our progressive coalition, the President canceled student loan debt, delivering necessary relief to 43 million borrowers.
Republicans know how big this victory is. **Now they want to go to COURT to stop student debt cancellation. Seriously?** The GOP will go to any length to block necessary relief for everyday people.
Working Americans are struggling every day under the weight of ever-growing student loan debt, the high cost of healthcare, and skyrocketing rent and housing prices. **In the richest country in the world, there is no reason why 43 million Americans should be burdened with debt.**
That’s why the Congressional Progressive Caucus worked for months on end with advocates from labor unions, civil rights organizations, and policy groups to push for real action on student debt. **And we won.**
**With any victory, there is backlash, and we all know that the GOP plays dirty.** So we must be prepared to protect this historic action through the midterm elections and after – no matter who gets elected this fall.
[**It’s imperative we keep our foot on the pedal. Will you consider contributing $3 to power our campaign while I continue to champion this historic student debt relief?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17155?refcode=em20220912-1611&t=1&akid=1611%2E420207%2EK01f79)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17155?refcode=em20220912-1611&t=20&akid=1611%2E420207%2EK01f79)**
The GOP wants to keep 43 million Americans (and counting) locked into decades of debt. But we won’t let them.
**The Congressional Progressive Caucus has played a crucial role in some of the biggest Democratic wins in years.** We passed an unprecedented climate action bill, successfully lobbied for historic student debt relief, and agreed on the first gun safety bill in decades.
It’s support from folks like you that keeps progressives like me in office and **in a position of power to negotiate such major federal actions.**
[**If you can donate $3 to our campaign today, you’ll help our campaign stay strong amidst GOP attacks so we can keep up the good fight come November and beyond. Can I count on your contribution?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17155?refcode=em20220912-1611&t=21&akid=1611%2E420207%2EK01f79)
Regardless of what the GOP throws at us, **we will remain ready for the fight ahead**. We have history on our side, and slowly but surely, we will keep moving forward.
In solidarity,
Pramila

**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20220912-1611-footer&t=22&refcode2=1611_420207_K01f79&akid=1611%2E420207%2EK01f79)**

clean_body: We're being outraised, we're down in a poll, and we need your help. | I have some bad news. FIRST: We haven't been able to launch our new ads everywhere across the state yet because we're behind on our fundraising. We're not raising enough money to keep up with Cheri Beasley, who has booked millions of dollars on the North Carolina airwaves. Our message isn't reaching critical voters. THEN: A new poll came out showing Ted Budd behind in the polls by 1 percent. NOW: As Cheri Beasley leads us in polls, she has millions of dollars in ads on the air. We might fall even further behind. We still need to raise thousands of dollars to get these ads on the air, and the sooner we reach that goal, the sooner we can get our ads on the air and fight back. | It's an uphill battle. Cheri Beasley is posting record-breaking fundraising numbers, and Democrats nationwide are pouring money into this race so she can flip the seat blue. She's a top fundraiser, and she's not afraid to spend that money. She is attacking us from all angles, and unfortunately, it is beginning to work. I'm humbly asking you to please support our campaign with any amount that you can. I wish I didn't have to ask for money so often, but the Left isn't giving up and we need to fight back. We're getting outraised, we're down in the polls, and we need you to step in and help. Thank you in advance. It's an honor to fight for you in this race. Sincerely, Ted Budd | Ted Budd is a father, small business owner, and conservative leader running for Senate in North Carolina. He is the ONLY candidate who is endorsed by President Trump and the only candidate who will fight for the America First Agenda in Washington. | | I invite everyone to my town hall and campaign trips. I answer all inquiries, phone calls, and emails — even those who disagree with me. I do it because I would represent all of us, more than my party and ideological circle. I want the voter to be informed. I encourage constituents — especially Jack Bergman — to debate and bring us tough questions. How can voters be informed when candidates refuse to debate or hold town halls? Voting based on the party isn't an informed voter; it isn't the crown jewel of our democracy. We can and should do better to preserve our American democracy. We are not just functionaries of our parties. This election isn't just Democrat vs. Republican; it's dignity and integrity vs. Bergman's deceit and deception. I am Dr. Bob running against Jack Bergman. Please share our messages with your family and friends in Michigan's 1st District. Help others get to know us and understand our character and principles — then, vote on what is important to you, your family, and your friends. Unlike my opponent, I support women's rights and private medical decision-making. I support your freedoms, our constitution, and your right to vote. I support education, healthcare, and the environment. Most importantly, I will never dishonor or try to undermine the will of the people or our democracy. We need principled leadership in Michigan's 1st District. I intend to bring integrity back to this Congressional seat. My opponent counts on division and discord, uninformed voters, and a disengaged electorate as a campaign strategy. Unaccountability is an embarrassing, undemocratic strategy to hold on to power. Help us spread the word by forwarding this email to your contacts in Northern Michigan and the UP, [retweet this](https://www.votedrbob.com/so/f8OCpQzQI/c?w=49eYCeZqRnEOUEQurOC4RXTFoBRGIEoUn6X-TgROi98.), and if you agree with my positions, get out the vote, volunteer, and encourage your friends and family to register. Thank you for your consideration, support and generosity. -Dr. Bob If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

body:
The Inflation Reduction Act is a win for the American people. | | | |
---
| | |
---
| [IWillVote.com](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=ac8c90e1aa&e=d6c5c7d7ec "IWillVote.com")
---
| **The Inflation Reduction Act’s Impact** Three things everyone should know about the Inflation Reduction Act: with this law, the American people won and special interests lost. Here are the three things everyone should know: 1. Democrats are lowering health care, prescription drug, and utility costs for working families. 2. Democrats sided with the American people and Republicans sided with special interests. Every single Republican opposed requiring big corporations to pay their fair share, and lowering costs for families. 3. President Biden and Democrats demonstrated that the government can work for working families. [Read President Biden’s full op-ed here.](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=2701259809&e=d6c5c7d7ec) Supporting Rural Communities:
* Access and affordability are significant challenges across rural America and the Democrats understand and are working to address those challenges. Thanks to the American Rescue Plan, 65 percent (1.3 million) of the 1.9 million uninsured rural Americans in states using the HealthCare.gov had access to a $0-premium health insurance plan for 2021. The Inflation Reduction Act will help keep free or low-cost health insurance available to rural Americans, with average savings of about $800 per person per year, while at the same time lowers prescription drug costs for seniors on Medicare.

Supporting Latino Communities:
* High prices contribute to racial and ethnic health inequities. Among adults 65 and older, Latino Medicare beneficiaries were roughly [1.5 times](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=2895ad2113&e=d6c5c7d7ec) as likely as White beneficiaries to have trouble affording medications, and about [2 times](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=78b030f95b&e=d6c5c7d7ec) as likely to not fill needed prescriptions due to cost. For example, a recent study of shingles vaccination rates among older Americans showed non-Latino White Americans were over [2 times](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=d92a8453c9&e=d6c5c7d7ec) as likely to have received the shingles vaccine than Latinos, due in part to difficulty affording the shingles vaccine. The Inflation Reduction Act will help close the gap in access to medication by improving prescription drug coverage and lowering drug prices in Medicare.

Supporting Black Communities:
* Almost [3.9 million Black people](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=81f9069a2d&e=d6c5c7d7ec) were uninsured in 2019 before President Biden took office and over [570,000 Black people](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=bf96dbf70a&e=d6c5c7d7ec) fell into the Medicaid “coverage gap” and were locked out of coverage because their state refused to expand Medicaid. Since President Biden took office, the uninsured rate has reached a new historic law: 8% and 5.2 million of Americans have gained health insurance coverage. The Inflation Reduction Act continues the American Rescue Plan’s more generous Affordable Care Act premium tax credits.

Supporting Tribal Communities:
* The Inflation Reduction Act includes investments for a Tribal Electrification Program for Tribes and Tribal organizations to provide electricity to unelectrified Tribal homes through zero-emission energy systems, and to transition electrified homes to zero-emission energy systems. The Inflation Reduction Act also provides additional investments for the Tribal Energy Loan Guarantee Program, and increases loan guarantees for Tribal energy development from $2 billion to $20 billion.

Supporting AANHPI Communities:
* According to the Small Business Administration, 2 million Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander-owned small businesses in the U.S. generate more than $700 billion in revenues and create 3.6 million jobs. The Inflation Reduction Act includes a number of provisions that will save small business owners money.

Supporting Young Americans:
* This law represents the single most aggressive action the U.S. is taking to tackle the climate crisis and create clean energy solutions in American history. The law will bring down energy costs for families and create thousands of good jobs, all while reducing climate pollution and ensuring that we have a clean, secure future energy supply. The law would reduce about a gigaton (a billion metric tons) of greenhouse gas emissions in 2030 and position America to meet President Biden’s climate goals of cutting climate pollution in half by 2030 and reaching net-zero emissions by no later than 2050.

* President Biden and Democrats rack up win after win: President Biden and congressional Democrats have beat special interests to deliver game-changing wins for American families including:
* Inflation Reduction Act to lower prescription drug, health insurance, and energy costs, and fight inflation – all while reducing the federal deficit and finally making big corporations and billionaire tax cheats pay their fair share.
* CHIPS and Science Act to lower costs, create American jobs, and increase competitiveness with China.
* PACT Act to ensure veterans get the health care benefits they’ve earned.
* Gun reform for the first time in 30 years.
* Bipartisan Infrastructure Law to fix our roads and bridges.
* American Rescue Plan to get us out of the pandemic by creating millions of jobs, funding our vaccination campaign, and reopening our schools.
* Gas prices are below $4 a gallon on average, and we have one of the best jobs markets in history as unemployment is matching a 50-year low.

---

Hello,
I was a three-star admiral, but when Donald Trump was elected, I voted with my feet and retired after 36 years in the U.S. Navy. Life is about choices, and I was not going to work for a demagogue such as Trump.
**Because here’s something you won’t hear anyone on Fox ‘Entertainment’ News admit: Donald J. Trump was – and still is – a national security threat.**
Trump wanted to withdraw from NATO, cozied up to our enemies, and alienated our allies. He attacked our democracy and incited an armed insurrection on our Capitol. He tried to hold military aid to Ukraine hostage, and who knows what kind of _kompromat_ Russia has on him...
Twice Donald Trump was impeached. And twice Chuck Grassley stood by his side. **It’s time for my opponent Senator Chuck Grassley to stand on a bit of principle and finally repudiate any affiliation with Donald Trump. If you don't stand against him, then you stand with him.**
I’m running for Senate because Republicans like Chuck Grassley are still acting like Trump’s lap dogs. They’ll do nothing to confront the climate crisis, take on Big Pharma and the NRA, or rein in Wall Street. And when I defeat Chuck Grassley, Iowa will be represented by the most senior military person ever-elected to the U.S. Senate. That sounds fitting right about now.
The polls show Chuck Grassley can be beaten. His approval ratings are lower than they’ve ever been. **But McConnell is raising millions into Super PACs to attack me with lie-filled ads, so if I’m going to win, I need grassroots donors like you to give now.**
**We’re facing a huge mid-month fundraising deadline, and right now we’re still very short of our $500,000 goal and what we need to keep our new TV ads up and turn Iowa blue.**

body:
The Inflation Reduction Act is a massive win for our environment, our families, our economy, and our future.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=921%2E61531%2E8LBbw1)
Hello,
Last month, Peter voted to pass the historic Inflation Reduction Act. You may have heard about it: this landmark bill includes a number of career-long Welch initiatives, including taking major steps to combat climate change and help to save our planet.
The Inflation Reduction Act will help the U.S. reduce its carbon emissions by 40 percent by the year 2030 while ALSO reducing the federal deficit by an estimated $300 billion through tax code changes that ensure our largest corporations pay their fair share.
Fighting climate change AND reducing the deficit?! That’s a massive win for Americans.
Peter and his Democratic colleagues are focused on bringing relief to folks across the country, but unfortunately, national Republicans (including Mitch McConnell and our opponent) all opposed this plan without offering up one of their own. Vermont deserves a Senator with real solutions for the real problems we’re facing, and Peter Welch is the only candidate in this race who fits that description.
[**We can do even more to protect our planet and fight climate change if we keep the Democratic majority, and we need Peter in the Senate fighting for us. If you believe in combating climate change, please chip in $5 or any amount you can to power Peter to victory ahead of this all-important election.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4145?t=3&akid=921%2E61531%2E8LBbw1)

For example: Through the IRA, Peter’s HOPE for HOMES Program will finally become law. Dating back to 2009, Peter’s fought nonstop for this program that will create jobs and help families make improvements at home to lower their energy usage, slash utility bills, and reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Because of Peter’s determination, he’s secured a major victory for our environment, our families, our economy, and our future.
Our opponent, on the other hand, supports increased oil drilling on public lands and has taken a public stance against the Green New Deal. If he wins this election, he’ll join with Mitch McConnell to undo all the progress we’ve made with this groundbreaking legislation, and we’ve got to ensure that doesn’t happen.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

The DNC was scheduled to vote this week on whether or not to ban
billionaire-funded super PACs from Democratic primaries. But the DNC shut
it down — the measure to stop the barrage of attacks against progressives
won’t even get a vote.

It’s not even a shock that the DNC is fine with corporate-funded super
PACs like AIPAC’s “United Democracy Project” spending millions on attack
ads targeting Justice Democrats Summer Lee and Jessica Cisneros.

Our work sets aim directly at defeating corporate Democrats in primaries
and transforming the mega-donor driven policies of the Democratic Party.
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/114284?refcode=em20220912-25108&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=25108%2E1203867%2EUowtrI ]Chip in right now to fuel our fight to change the political status quo
in the Democratic Party. Every grassroots donation funds our next primary
and our next victory against billionaire mega-donors.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/114284?refcode=em20220912-25108&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=25108%2E1203867%2EUowtrI ]Contribute

While the DNC and DCCC easily raise hundreds of millions of dollars every
election cycle and corporate super PACs get what they need when they need
it from their billionaire donors, Justice Democrats is funded by the
people. You can see why we have to work hard to contend with corporate
Democrats in our primaries.

We don’t have the money corporate Democrats have, but your donations allow
us to strategically invest in primaries and secure victories — like we did
this year with new JDs Summer Lee and Greg Casar, and helping the Squad
win their primaries. The more we receive from supporters like you, the
better our chances are of winning primaries AND expanding the number of
races we can run in.

We’re in this together and your donations directly lead to our success.
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/114284?refcode=em20220912-25108&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=25108%2E1203867%2EUowtrI ]So, Peter,
can you chip in $3 today and help us combat the unlimited
corporate influence in the Democratic Party?

Thank you for your continued support.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1023&akid=25108%2E1203867%2EUowtrI ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the

| | | __**[You may not know me, so let me share my story.](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=197090d5ceb84f4aa7c56be2e7a654ff&_e=oBnIzZXr6vF3h01Bzu3iZk707Vtj4JT5QswH3RqaFKQcOf61ntOa-hfBcbvKHuKlIWGf8zU-NJOXwIcwBcKqMRtn_VlD_Ug-KjC_w6hC0T5tkwUx07f3yr2uoHCSI9XA_YANqORNDBFTwFoIXPJdYA_oeMbqa14WJ7Pfoulkb6HZ1zXITWnrvlxzVr9v9NybVzNB-UGLcA5Slv58lezDSbg4eAPrPPLx__RK7NUvwgk2vWFPE3QsLbmi0zXeydBkB3Qw1iXwIy6J2Oq0J4PByvdmQyFviiOXlLoPQ2BNs5T47Z8JwQfseQ6jUWMEaT3juE0XK9vYl-kJRBO5TbR4_VamWIqxHUNIVd_C5P4i2-GSR439-tig63tfTOcRSoHeNiEW951FjWMj0r6sRLp0GVwMeO24i4cbm_kqbRBYMwI%3D "You may not know me, so let me share my story.")**__
My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of three, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

Now, I need _your_ help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.

---
| | [HELP TIFFANY'S CAMPAIGN](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=197090d5ceb84f4aa7c56be2e7a654ff&_e=oBnIzZXr6vF3h01Bzu3iZk707Vtj4JT5QswH3RqaFKQcOf61ntOa-hfBcbvKHuKlIWGf8zU-NJOXwIcwBcKqMRtn_VlD_Ug-KjC_w6hC0T5tkwUx07f3yr2uoHCSI9XA_YANqORNDBFTwFoIXPJdYA_oeMbqa14WJ7Pfoulkb6HZ1zXITWnrvlxzVr9v9NybVzNB-UGLcA5Slv58lezDSbg4eAPrPPLx__RK7NUvwgk2vWFPE3QsLbmi0zXeydBkB3Qw1iXwIy6J2Oq0J4PByuIaWL9j__9_4iwgMvlOdREQKTAQFa3tL4V9SCsMLmCp25nYLJP8_J6ZTMEvp6GNNzwBdEbUtHZs730kmkE6rDWPX5HmGMpWSJc1SO3Z78sECm7DL5FQ_4wQOdSFc8sWlhxJ5_jC0ybSEw0ZFEldaRw%3D "HELP TIFFANY’S CAMPAIGN")
---

Murray has been in office for _**three decades**_ and has done **nothing** to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the failed leadership they've been stuck with for _years_.

It's time for a _**change**_ in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be _**neck and neck**_ , and I'm getting nervous. We're _finally_ closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

_**[Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington?](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=197090d5ceb84f4aa7c56be2e7a654ff&_e=oBnIzZXr6vF3h01Bzu3iZk707Vtj4JT5QswH3RqaFKQcOf61ntOa-hfBcbvKHuKlIWGf8zU-NJOXwIcwBcKqMRtn_VlD_Ug-KjC_w6hC0T5tkwUx07f3yr2uoHCSI9XA_YANqORNDBFTwFoIXPJdYA_oeMbqa14WJ7Pfoulkb6HZ1zXITWnrvlxzVr9v9NybVzNB-UGLcA5Slv58lezDSbg4eAPrPPLx__RK7NUvwgk2vWFPE3QsLbmi0zXeydBkB3Qw1iXwIy6J2Oq0J4PByvmqH4z6kYe4cbuCSLkcz6sOpcpOv25pmErjgiwyiBTcEO-_eRRCmD5qbFczhfAJJ-H8ijN_kF26LxPbNS2DgB-TEaznnS44GQBUyJ3wtUYGxgT6KmLIRDafDYdbSdM81az23LzI2xnzvkBslEQTaZc%3D "Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington? Fellow Conservative,

More than ten years ago, I stepped off the bus and into Officer Basic Training to become a Marine.

During Officer Basic Training, I went through weapons and combat training, extensive military history classes, and drill – but beyond all the physical training, I was taught that **everything is earned, never given**.

After countless hours, too many pull-ups to count, and hard work – I was commissioned as an Officer, got my official pin, and earned my spot in the Marines. It wasn’t easy. _Things that are great rarely are._

Today, I’m training to serve my country in a different capacity. Instead of weapons and combat training, I’m knocking on doors, and talking to constituents. Rather than history lessons, I’m sending emails just like this one. I subbed out pull-ups for putting up campaign signs.

All this training is still for the same purpose: **to serve Americans and protect our great nation from threats both foreign and domestic.**

Peter,

We're less than 8 weeks away from Election Day, and every major political forecaster is calling the Georgia Senate race a "Toss-Up."

Earlier this week, _Politico_ issued updated rankings of the top Senate races in the nation and concluded much the same that _FiveThirtyEight_ , Crystal Ball, and Cook Political Reports have before them: **Georgia is anyone's race.**

Democrats have now spent more than $37 million on misleading attack ads against me, my family, and my business - yet polls remain a dead heat. **[That means we can win this race.](http://links.keepingamericagreatalerts.com/u/click?_t=b17b139d3aa34869835631e0135927b3&_m=11663993839749ec9d190e72fd28a8a0&_e=4wTJFemFJWqmy7TXCf7ewtO5SLYBcuVRjcA727ELN79R0ZMkVKhxRECc2FuGUB_kFgLdJGRdsyoDGCalVr75T_4X2MdFl_vlj8rKEaGgdYBTDCRs9DlceaEFcwK_62ThX61IEl6kOu7h8Tw5x5o2o3HDNHgDXaw0bA_RvPG3mYg2POLFKVyBxsokxKm_86rFj06khap12v9PBx-4EpJDzWYSa9fW3uYlhOeWI8vrrokJF75TeFnU1HChNJka0XDQWS4covwralO_0vRmIiudNEeyaK_BUeF0v8SzdZzKtG03dX6r_IZjRHu1xH-RAzAaCzArk1euNBuXueQFdRGQ3GSrzfK0uH9_DaCFG1VDckSCs9Tu8wd21B8V74cHe1GtZhvL1ohhg8ZaRZ65e5GixW99U2Z5-Y2HYZtjiCiExLCKghr-cS1JPVzmPPRmBoV3)**

A victory in Georgia is going to have widespread implications for every single American - not just those of us who live in the Peach State.

So, if you want Kamala Harris to have the tie-breaking vote in the Senate for another two years, then pay no attention to this race. But if you're tired of the political gamesmanship in DC and our country going in the wrong direction, **[then I'm asking you to chip in what you can- $10, $24, $34, or even $50 right now.](http://links.keepingamericagreatalerts.com/u/click?_t=b17b139d3aa34869835631e0135927b3&_m=11663993839749ec9d190e72fd28a8a0&_e=4wTJFemFJWqmy7TXCf7ewtO5SLYBcuVRjcA727ELN79R0ZMkVKhxRECc2FuGUB_kFgLdJGRdsyoDGCalVr75T_4X2MdFl_vlj8rKEaGgdYBTDCRs9DlceaEFcwK_62ThX61IEl6kOu7h8Tw5x5o2o3HDNHgDXaw0bA_RvPG3mYg2POLFKVyBxsokxKm_86rFj06khap12v9PBx-4EpJDzWYSa9fW3uYlhOeWI8vrrokJF75TeFnU1HChNJka0XDQWS4covwralO_0vRmIiudNEeyaK_BUeF0v8SzdZzKtG0RrFXIlkyQyvt6eb21NHCml0bcNckq2_J-nql6-sRYp4DHjghsARzZVbWFKLlyBG7zYh7JTSPI-nfs2grD_FhxgM9Yjzg5wAbGv5RJEi-8QB8zk01ZMa7718ohqMP7U8mL3CPeCCREths4bdHQXCEg)**

We're on a collision course with Senator Raphael Warnock, and there can only be one winner. Peter, I've never liked losing, and I don't intend to start now.

Please help us move the needle - **[chip in what you can today to move this race from TOSS-UP to LEAN REPUBLICAN...with a huge VICTORY on Election Day!](http://links.keepingamericagreatalerts.com/u/click?_t=b17b139d3aa34869835631e0135927b3&_m=11663993839749ec9d190e72fd28a8a0&_e=4wTJFemFJWqmy7TXCf7ewtO5SLYBcuVRjcA727ELN79R0ZMkVKhxRECc2FuGUB_kFgLdJGRdsyoDGCalVr75T_4X2MdFl_vlj8rKEaGgdYBTDCRs9DlceaEFcwK_62ThX61IEl6kOu7h8Tw5x5o2o3HDNHgDXaw0bA_RvPG3mYg2POLFKVyBxsokxKm_86rFj06khap12v9PBx-4EpJDzWYSa9fW3uYlhOeWI8vrrokJF75TeFnU1HChNJka0XDQWS4covwralO_0vRmIiudNEeyaK_BUeF0v8SzdZzKtG0USDIifhQAFzIqNqMLtI3yJDa5HXiY7m_YxdITMSVMU6YwpZFB9qPbKOy7DIW0rMA8cOs4rL39ImiZng5rjD7NvbCw_ao3M1PXEUkVFLJ_ybmXKV3JmH3dhLaZoRy7ISFL6HFBwxVsDyx9fYdFCYwG)**

With this race consistently rated a TOSS-UP, we've got to make sure we leave no stone left unturned and no vote left unaccounted for. **With more than 7,004,000 active voters in Georgia, the next two months are going to require a lot of resources to identify - and contact - every eligible voter to make our case.**
